--- Page 9 ---
<meta>This page follows an introductory dedication or title leaf. This document was crucial for protecting the author's intellectual and financial interests across the Holy Roman Empire.</meta>

# S U M M A R Y
## OF THE 
### I M P E R I A L   P R I V I L E G E.

BY THE <term>PRIVILEGE</term> <note>A legal grant of exclusive rights issued by the Emperor, acting as an early form of copyright protection.</note> OF HIS SACRED IMPERIAL MAJESTY,
*it is cautioned that no copper-plate engraver, carver, sculptor, printer, bookseller, or others engaged in any manner of book-related trade, shall presume—without the will and consent of the aforementioned Doctor Heinrich Khunrath or his heirs—to copy, reprint, or arrange to be reprinted elsewhere, or bring in, sell, or distribute openly or secretly, the* **W O R K S  O F  H E I N R I C H  K H U N R A T H, OF L E I P Z I G**, *Doctor of Medicine.*

*These works include both the written and the illustrated, whether* <term>Medical</term>, <term>Chemical</term> <note>original: "Chymica." In this period, "chemistry" and "alchemy" were not yet distinct disciplines.</note>, <term>Kabbalistic</term> <note>Khunrath was a primary proponent of "Christian Kabbalah," which combined Jewish mystical traditions with Hermetic philosophy and Christian theology.</note>, *and many other more secret matters, in both the Latin and German languages, partly sought from other sources and partly composed and invented by himself. And notably among these works, the* **A M P H I T H E A T E R  O F  E T E R N A L  W I S D O M**, *of the only true [wisdom], Christian-Kabbalistic, Divine-Magical, and Physico-Chemical, the triune universal [remedy]* <note>original: "tertriunum Catholicon." This refers to a "universal" substance or truth that is three-in-one, likely referencing the alchemical trinity of Salt, Sulfur, and Mercury, or a spiritual equivalent.</note>, *etc.*

*This protection is granted for a span of ten years, to be calculated from the first day of any edition's publication, within the boundaries of the Holy Roman Empire and the hereditary Kingdoms and Dominions of His Majesty. No one may imitate these in the same or any other typeface and format, whether in whole or in part. If anyone indeed, by acting otherwise, should dare to despise, neglect, or transgress this Imperial Privilege and interdict with reckless daring, he shall not only be deprived of all those copies so improperly reprinted and brought in (which the aforementioned Heinrich Khunrath, or his heirs and their agents, may claim for themselves wherever they are found, either by their own authority—which we grant them in this regard—or with the help of the local Magistrate)...*

<a><note>This "a" at the bottom of the page is a signature mark, used by early modern printers to ensure the pages were bound in the correct order.</note></a>

<summary>This page contains the formal legal warning (Privilege) granted by the Holy Roman Emperor, protecting Heinrich Khunrath’s diverse works—specifically his "Amphitheater"—from unauthorized copying and sale for ten years.</summary>

<keywords>Imperial Privilege, copyright, Heinrich Khunrath, Leipzig, Amphitheater of Eternal Wisdom, Kabbalah, Alchemy, Holy Roman Empire, book trade</keywords>

## VII.

To each of the **SCIENCES & ARTS**, through which the most pleasing fame of **GOD** has been spread throughout the world; but especially to those more sublime and secret ones, which are performed **Spagyrically** <term>Spagyric: A term for alchemy, specifically the art of separating and recombining elements to purify them.</term> with the aid of **FIRE**, which proves all things:

# AMPHITHEATER
# OF ETERNAL WISDOM
### OF THE ONLY TRUE ONE,

->*also*<-

to those most chaste [Arts], like Virgins, almost from her holy and most secret chambers; among all the good Sciences and Arts in the whole world useful to the human race, none are more noble or holy, none more excellent (on account of their **USES** and **FRUITS**, both Macro- and Micro-cosmic, as well as **DIVINE**, being salutary here and for eternity), namely,

# CABALA, MAGIC, ALCHEMY,

serving most prudently and truly as **THEO-** and **PHILO-SOPHICAL** <note>theo-sophically and philo-sophically: Khunrath combines "Theosophy" (divine wisdom) and "Philosophy" (love of wisdom) to describe a science that is both spiritual and natural.</note> handmaidens to their most holy and wonderful **HEROINE** <note>The "Heroine" here refers to Eternal Wisdom, or Sophia.</note>, in the **ORATORY** <term>Oratory: A place for prayer and meditation.</term> & **LABORATORY** <term>Laboratory: A place for physical alchemical work.</term>, **Macro- and Micro-COSMICALLY**, by a miraculous and manifold craftsmanship; according to the standard of the holier and **CHRISTIAN PHILOSOPHY**, the only true Truth; necessarily purged from the painted masks of diabolical and execrable sophisms <note>sophisms: false arguments or deceptive practices.</note> falsely substituting themselves for **TRUTH**, by the guidance and assistance of the **SPIRIT OF THE WISDOM OF GOD** <note>original: "R V A C H  H H O C H M A H - E L." This is Hebrew (רוח חכמה אל) for the Spirit of Divine Wisdom.</note>, and sincerely reformed with universal <note>original: "catholica." Here meaning "universal" rather than referring specifically to the Roman Catholic Church.</note> dexterity according to the pattern of the Archetype, or worthily
->restituted and<-
->restored<-
to their triune and universal primordial Simplicity and Goodness,

<summary>Khunrath dedicates his work to the "handmaidens" of Wisdom—Cabala, Magic, and Alchemy—defining them as holy arts that must be practiced in both the chapel and the workshop. He emphasizes the need to rescue these arts from "diabolical" distortions and restore them to their original, God-given purity.</summary>

--- Page 14 ---
<meta>This page serves as the primary title page for the "Amphitheater of Eternal Wisdom." It continues directly from the previous page's unfinished word "CHR...", which completes here as "CHRISTIANO-CABALISTICVM." This title page formally defines the scope of Khunrath's work, bridging the gap between divine revelation (Cabala) and physical experimentation (Alchemy).</meta>

# CHRISTIAN-CABALISTIC,
# DIVINE-MAGIC,
->also<-
# PHYSICO-CHEMICAL,
# TRIPLE-TRIUNE, UNIVERSAL,
->This [Work];<-

In which is taught Theo- and Philo-sophically <note>Khunrath combines "Theosophy" (divine wisdom) and "Philosophy" (love of wisdom) to describe a science that is both spiritual and natural.</note> the fountain of **TRUE WISDOM**, and its study—that is, the purer **PHILOSOPHY**. Here is shown the vein of genuine **UNDERSTANDING** of the Divine <term>Numen: The divine will, presence, or "nod" of God within the natural world.</term> and the essential **LIGHT OF NATURE** <term>Lumen Naturae: The "Light of Nature," a concept in Paracelsian thought referring to the innate intelligence or divine spark within the physical world that allows humans to understand it through observation.</term> existing universally in the **GREAT WORLD** <note>The Macrocosm or the universe at large.</note>, and specifically in its **SON**, namely the **MAGNESIA** of the Sages <term>Magnesia of the Sages: In alchemy, this is not the chemical element magnesium, but a "prime matter" or secret substance capable of attracting and holding the universal spirit.</term>, existing synoptically, universally, and in reality. Here also is shown the **RIGHT OR LAW OF GOD** written Divinely in our hearts; as well as the method of correctly understanding and orthodoxly interpreting the **SACRED BIBLE**; and the **KNOWLEDGE** of the Tree of Life, of Good and Evil, and of things Honorable and Base.

A **WORK**, both theoretical and practical, attested by personal observation <note>original: "autopsia," meaning first-hand experience or "seeing for oneself."</note> (despite critics like Momus and Zoilus <note>Momus and Zoilus: Classical mythological and historical figures used as personifications of carping, unfair, or malicious critics.</note>), truly extraordinary, recently revised, and arranged **AMPHITHEATRICALLY** <note>The "Amphitheater" refers to a comprehensive, 360-degree view of the subjects, structured through the book's elaborate circular engravings.</note> with **FOUR** circular figures and other hieroglyphic **IMAGES** skillfully engraved in copper. It is published to rescue and lift up **TRUTH** (which suffers the most unjust violence publicly and everywhere without shame, groaning as if collapsing under the weight of slanders, and—alas!—nearly succumbing) from destruction with all our strength; and so that a worthy opportunity might be provided to other good and industrious men to attempt and achieve the same. It is now at last—and only just in time—sent forth into public view from a pious heart for the sake of **CHRISTENDOM** and the common **UTILITY** of the world (but soon enough, if, as I hope, it is done well enough);

**TRUE WISDOM**, teaching in a Christian manner **TO WHOM, WHAT, WHERE, BY WHAT MEANS, HOW LONG, WHY, HOW, and WHEN** it can and ought to happen; and the **SUPREME GOOD OF MAN**, fruitful in the future life as well as in this one, the singular gift of **GOD**, triple-triune, most universal, namely,

<meta>catchword: Recognition</meta>

<summary>This is the main title page of Khunrath's "Amphitheatrum," outlining his synthesis of Cabala, Magic, and Alchemy as a unified path to understanding God and Nature. He presents the work as a defense of "Truth" against its critics and a practical guide for the spiritual and physical benefit of mankind.</summary>

# TO THE SINCERE
## READER
->GREETINGS.<-

A<gloss>historiated initial</gloss> MPHITHEATRE, THIS REMARKABLE 
WORK, *in which the Author, Heinrich Khunrath of Leipzig, Doctor of both Medicine & Philosophy,* 
has proposed to all, with admirable industry, 
DIVINE, HUMAN, MACRO- AND MICROCOSMIC WISDOM: <note>Khunrath views wisdom as a spectrum ranging from God (Divine) to the universe (Macrocosm) and the human being (Microcosm).</note> 
*Divine-Magical, Christian-Kabbalistic* <note>Kabbalah is a tradition of Jewish mysticism; Khunrath "Christianized" it by applying its methods to the study of Christ.</note> 
*& Physio-Chemical,* <note>An early term for alchemy, emphasizing the physical transformation of matter alongside spiritual growth.</note> 
to be looked upon with the EYES: contemplated with the MIND, 
pursued by Work, in the Oratory & Laboratory, <note>Khunrath's famous motto: "Ora et Labora" (Pray and Work). He believed spiritual devotion in the oratory was inseparable from chemical experiments in the laboratory.</note> 
*O Sincere and Friendly Reader, we give to you now whole and complete. The Author* 
*himself, indeed, having been prevented by an untimely death, left it behind* 
*somewhat, but not greatly, unfinished. He placed that burden upon my truly* 
*unequal shoulders as he was dying, so that this* WORK *might be brought to* 
*light through my posthumous care: both because I was joined to him in intimate* 
*friendship, and because he made me a participant in his plan for publishing* 
*this work, along with other more secret things left by him. I have therefore* 
*diligently taken care that it should go forth into the public in such a way as I* 
*clearly understood he himself wished it to go forth. If everyone is not* 
*satisfied in many things, let them consider the magnitude of the* MATTER 
*and let them do better things than these. It remains that I advise you in a few* 
*words regarding the goal of the Work: how much the human mind naturally* 
DESIRES TO KNOW *is admitted by all. How many volumes of books are* 
*unrolled for the sake of the Sciences? how many hardships are devoured?* 
*how many expenses are incurred? how many late-night studies, vigils,* 
*and labors are exhausted? the end of all of which is at last either vanity or* 
*poverty, often even broken strength of the body and delirium of the soul;* 
*human reason shows a way and access so difficult toward that shadowy* 
*Philosophy. Theosophy, however, does otherwise: in this* WORK, *for it* 
*does not first consist of so many labors and expenses. Hear Wisdom Herself* 
*speaking to you:*

> *She is easily seen by those who love her, and found by those who seek her:* <note>A paraphrase of the Wisdom of Solomon 6:12 from the Apocrypha.</note>

<summary>This preface by the book's editor explains that Heinrich Khunrath died before finishing the "Amphitheatre," leaving the final publication to a close friend. It defines the work as a guide to "Theosophy"—a divine wisdom more accessible and rewarding than the exhausting, "shadowy" pursuit of traditional academic philosophy.</summary>

*She anticipates those who desire her, so that she may reveal herself to them first. Whoever wakes early for her will not labor, for he will find her* SITTING <note>original: *assistentem*; literally "standing by" or "attending."</note> *at his doors. Furthermore, she is not occupied with so many troubles. For her company has no bitterness, nor her conversation any weariness, but rather joy and gladness.* Therefore, this Wisdom of ours is most easy and spontaneous. All such things are the TRUE GIFTS OF GOD. *But the frauds of the world, the Illusions, Phantasms, and the Sophistry of the Devil, consist of much labor and expense.*

*Finally, you must be discouraged from holding this Work in contempt. It is the mark of a foolish and unfit man to judge a matter not yet read, or to despise what is not understood. I ask you, are the stars to be despised just because you do not recognize them? Or are the Plants, which our fertile mother Earth offers us, to be cast aside and trampled because you do not perceive their* signature <note>The "Doctrine of Signatures" was the belief that plants' physical characteristics (like shape or color) were "signed" by God to indicate their medicinal uses.</note> *and hidden powers? How many useless and fatuous offspring does human Wit give birth to? And yet, you often give them the primary place in your Library, and they hold the first seats at your table among philosophical things.* Remember, therefore, that this <term>AMPHITHEATER</term> <note>original: *Amphitheatrum*; in the 17th century, this term referred to a comprehensive display or "theater" of knowledge where a whole subject could be viewed at once.</note> does not propose to show your eyes a false or foolish Philosophy: but the contemplation of ETERNAL WISDOM, THE ONLY TRUE ONE, which you might neglect or despise to your great harm and destruction. *FAREWELL, and enjoy this Amphitheater, for the Recognition of GOD, Knowledge of yourself, discernment of Nature, for the illumination of the Soul, purity of the Spirit, and health of the Body. Given at Wernigerode in the illustrious County of Stolberg at the Brocken* <note>original: *Bructerum*; referring to Mount Brocken, the highest peak in the Harz mountains of Germany.</note> *on the Ides of March,* <note>The 15th of March.</note> *in the Year of the health-bringing Virginal birth 1 6 0 9.*

### BY THEOPHILUS ARETIUS <note>Literally "Virtuous Lover of God"; likely a pseudonym for a friend or colleague of Khunrath.</note>

# ON THAT GREAT AND WONDERFUL AMPHITHEATER OF THE MOST RENOWNED MAN, MASTER HENRICUS KHUNRATH OF LEIPZIG, DOCTOR OF BOTH MEDICINES <note>Usually referring to Medicine and Alchemical Philosophy, or Medicine and Law.</note>, AND RESTORER OF TRUE WISDOM AND THE STUDY THEREOF,

## A POEM OF PRAISE.

*IF anyone should look more deeply into the hidden mysteries of the Divine Word, and hide himself within its innermost shrines, he will perceive nothing but the commerce of men with the heavenly beings.*
*Happy souls, whom such great grace has blessed, to hear angelic tongues in a mortal body, and to feel the voice of GOD in a human breast!*
*Where has that day fled? Where does the golden ladder of heaven now lie hidden, by which the heavenly ones descend? Or who will unlock the sacred entrances, and lead us to the pious Gods?*
*Believe me, he who strives for such things enters a difficult path; for the Divine Powers dwelling in the starry lights are not manifest to everyone.*
*Yet if we believe that angelic minds were once delighted by human fellowship, I believe there is a hidden art: the ancient Fathers knew it.*
*It has perished: just as the Sun is submerged in the deep Ocean, soon formless shadows and incurable error prevailed; and the liar <note>Referring to the Devil or the Spirit of Lies.</note> raised his head from the underworld.*
*There is a pure fountain of WISDOM: Divine CABALA <term>Cabala</term> <note>A form of Jewish mysticism that Christian scholars of the Renaissance adapted to explain the relationship between the eternal God and the mortal/finite universe.</note>, and that which the MAGI <note>The "Wise Men" or ancient practitioners of sacred science.</note> hold, redolent with Sabaean incense <note>Incense from the biblical land of Sheba (modern Yemen).</note>, and to which he gave the name GREEN <note>original: *Viride*; likely referring to the "Green Lion" or the "Greenness" of nature in alchemical transformation.</note>, and the silent MOLTEN SALT <note>original: *Sal fusile*; a technical alchemical term for a specific state of matter or a "fixed" salt.</note>.*
*No one shall possess this triple Wisdom of GOD without the Divine Power—Theological, Astronomical, and the Healing Diana <note>In this context, Diana (the Moon) likely represents the "Lunar" or silver stage of alchemy and the healing arts of nature.</note>—no one is great and exalted without Divine inspiration.*
*Triple Wisdom flows from a single blessed source: the ethereal Spirit, and the Mind poured through all things, which gives life to the lands and fills the sea, the stars, and the air.*
*The King of Peace <note>King Solomon, whose name means "Peaceful."</note> shall be my witness, who once held as many gems of Wisdom in his breast as there are sands upon the shores; in whose heart Wisdom had built a high fortress.*

<summary>A laudatory poem by Theophilus Aretius praising Heinrich Khunrath for restoring the "triple wisdom" of the ancients. It frames Khunrath's work as a rediscovery of lost divine secrets including Cabala and alchemy, once known to figures like Solomon.</summary>

<keywords>Theophilus Aretius, Heinrich Khunrath, Amphitheater of Eternal Wisdom, Triple Wisdom, Cabala, Alchemy, Sal fusile, King Solomon, Divine Inspiration</keywords>

--- Page 20 ---
<meta>This page continues the praise poem by Theophilus Aretius. It lists a lineage of "true wisdom" passing from biblical patriarchs to Hermetic figures and Renaissance scholars, ultimately identifying this wisdom as the "Light of Nature" found in Khunrath's work.</meta>

How often would these fathers call the beautiful dove from the mountain of Lebanon <note>A reference to the Song of Solomon 4:8, often interpreted by alchemists as the soul or the "mercurial spirit."</note>, repeating sighs from the depths of their hearts? For they had chosen her as their one companion for life. "Come, my beloved," prays your dearest husband, the King of Jerusalem <note>Solomon, traditionally viewed as the master of divine and natural secrets.</note>; he swears by the sacred Powers that he will be a constant and chaste husband to you.

Abraham, relying on his conversations with JEHOVAH <note>original: "IHOVANIS"</note>, was skilled in this art; having departed from the Chaldean race, he brought it to Egypt and revealed it to the lands of Edom. This science of things was known to you, Jacob—to you JEHOVAH appeared, to you the Ladder of GOD was seen, and the royal palace of the open sky; you filled the flock of Rachel with spotted offspring <note>A reference to Jacob's use of "peeled rods" to influence the breeding of Laban's livestock (Genesis 30), viewed by alchemists as an early use of natural magic.</note>. Joseph held this wisdom while he cautiously interpreted the dreams of the Egyptian King <note>original: "Pharii regis," referring to Pharaoh.</note>; as a prophet, he sang of things to come through his mystic cups.

Moses, raised in the Egyptian court, drank this in; through this, and glowing afterward with divine light (this was a twin light <note>Likely referring to the dual illumination of grace and the Light of Nature.</note>), he was able to stand before JEHOVAH himself. Through this, Balaam—while still sincere and free from the crime of base greed—knew how to rightly search the secrets of the high GOD and bless the holy people. Through this, the skilled Queen of the Arabs <note>The Queen of Sheba.</note> brought riddles to the King of the Jews <note>Solomon.</note>, than whom no other shone more wisely. Through this, Daniel—more excellent than the Magi—was raised and instructed by the royal school of Persia; he declared the most sorrowful fates to two kings: one fell from his Empire, while the other became like a beast <note>Referring to Nebuchadnezzar’s madness.</note>.

How great a name did the thrice-great Hermes <note>Hermes Trismegistus, the legendary founder of the Hermetic tradition.</note> carry because of this? This wisdom, having worshipped GOD, visited the cradle of CHRIST. Reuchlin <note>Johannes Reuchlin (1455–1522), a German humanist and scholar of the Kabbalah.</note> taught the same through the *Wondrous Word* <note>original: "VERBO Mirifico," referring to Reuchlin's work *De Verbo Mirifico*.</note>. The sagacious Agrippa <note>Heinrich Cornelius Agrippa, author of *Three Books of Occult Philosophy*.</note> brought it forth with his marvelous mouth. The Swiss <note>original: "Heluetius," referring to Paracelsus (Theophrastus von Hohenheim), who was from Switzerland.</note>, the son of the Muses, a second Hermes, brought it forth—though he was hated by your own people: he is a vast light to the Wise, whose wisdom surpasses human senses. Rejoice in this sun, Germany, as you would in Apollo. And Stellatus <note>Marcello Palingenio Stellato, author of the *Zodiacus Vitae*, a popular 16th-century didactic poem.</note> preserves this in honeyed song.

<margin>2 }</margin>

This is, this is that very Science (believe me) which opens to you the **Light of Nature** and the hidden powers of the vast world. It is the clearest light, without which all things lie submerged in deep darkness. This is your torch; this is your light; this guide, leading the way, will bring you suddenly to the hidden inner chambers of all things.

And thus, you will not be a useless weight in this **Wondrous Theater**, nor an idle spectator, but a Searcher and an Actor; you will be an intimate guest, not a stranger always wandering outside. By this, he reveals the courses and powers of the stars, and having searched the changes of things, he marks their fixed times.

<summary>This page traces the "perennial philosophy" from Abraham and Solomon to Renaissance figures like Paracelsus and Agrippa, framing Khunrath's work as the ultimate guide to the "Light of Nature." It invites the reader to move from being a mere spectator to an active participant in the secrets of the universe.</summary>

<keywords>Light of Nature, Jacob's Ladder, Solomon, Hermes Trismegistus, Paracelsus, Reuchlin, Agrippa, Abraham, Daniel, Biblical Alchemy, Hermeticism</keywords>

*This power of the winds and the surging tide of the Sea became known,*
*From which the birth and life of the sown crops arise: from which it teaches*
*The growth of things, and how to draw out treasures from the veins of the earth.*
*It has resolved these three principles of all things.* <note>The "three principles" (Tria Prima) of Paracelsian alchemy: Salt, Sulfur, and Mercury.</note>

*Medicine is your invention, O GODDESS: by your power*
*They yield and are driven out; dissolved dropsy; knotty Gout;*
*And Leprosy—alas—fouling the living corpse with its filth:*
*The cough-bearing Wasting* <note>Consumption or tuberculosis.</note> *with burning flames, devouring*

*Hail, gentle parent; hail, long-awaited light!*
*You have come at last, dispelling the clouds from the sky.*
*I congratulate you, HEINRICH, that you have chosen this one as your friend,*
*O immortal glory of the Wise Men of Asclepius:* <note>The "Asclepiads" or followers of Asclepius, the Greek god of medicine; essentially, the elite physicians.</note>
*Offspring of the Graces, pleasing to GOD; Divine Prometheus;* <note>Prometheus is invoked here as a symbol of the seeker who brings divine fire/knowledge down to humanity.</note>
*Worthy of the heavens, who brings wonders to the Light in a new AMPHITHEATER:* <note>A direct reference to Khunrath’s masterpiece, the *Amphitheatrum Sapientiae Aeternae* (Amphitheater of Eternal Wisdom).</note>
*Things scarcely seen in all the theaters of the ancients.*
*Let sluggish envy, the stupid croaking of frogs, and the hissing of hell*
*Yield to better omens; O how happy is that labor,*
*How sweet the sweat, and how blessed the care?*
*O how fruitful the fruits, O how pleasant the journey*
*That was once so wearying? That golden birth of the jeweled powder* <note>The "powder of projection" or the Philosopher's Stone, often described as a red or golden jeweled substance.</note>
*By your hands shall place you in the light of the gods above.*
*O Glory of the Muses,* <note>original: "Aonidum," referring to the Muses of the Aonian fount.</note> *my Pylades,* <note>Pylades was the legendary loyal friend of Orestes; used here to signify deep friendship.</note> *live the years of Nestor;* <note>Nestor was the elderly, wise king in the Iliad, famous for living through three generations.</note>
*Live; farewell; and do not ascend to the heavenly dwellings, leaving the earth,*
*Until you surpass the summits of Medicine, Chymistry,* <note>term: Chymie (Alchemy/Chemistry). In this period, the terms were not yet distinct.</note> *and the divine Kabbalah,* <note>term: Cabalæ (Kabbalah). Khunrath synthesized Jewish mysticism with Christian alchemy.</note>
*And place the final peaks upon the highest rooftops.*
*Live long, be firmly well, and die blessedly.*

# DOCTOR OF BOTH MEDICINES <note>The "two medicines" typically refer to traditional Galenic medicine (physic) and Paracelsian alchemical medicine (hermetic/spagyric), or the healing of both body and soul.</note>, PHILOSOPHER

## CONCERNING THE
# AMPHITHEATER

*There is no need to visit the ruined theaters of the ancients,*
*Nor new ones, rendered vain by their own spectacles.*
*Rather, let one cast off the filthy world, and cast off himself,*
*And flee the entangling mists.*
*Enter the orchestra <note>In ancient theaters, the orchestra was the circular space for the chorus; here, it refers to the central stage of Khunrath’s philosophical arena.</note> of your Theater, KHUNRATH,*
*With the good little fire of the heavens leading the way.*
*Where Divine Wisdom shows in an Emerald mirror <note>A reference to the "Smaragdine" or Emerald Tablet of Hermes Trismegistus, a foundational text of alchemy.</note>*

*And both scatter worthy riches upon the worthy.*
*Which you, KHUNRATH, offspring of a noble Genius,*
*Open in your wide Theater, while the envious fret.*
*Proceed thus: the base of your Theater is destined to remain firm,*
*As long as the Macrocosm shall be, as long as the Microcosm shall be.*

### BY THEODORUS AQUILINUS, POET LAUREATE: <note>Theodorus Aquilinus is a pseudonym often used by Khunrath himself; it translates to "The Gift of God, of the Eagle."</note>

WHY do you call the futile, rejected Muses to my care,
O Sophist?
Hearts dedicated to GOD are not open to Apollo,
Nor do they yield to the Muses.
That was once a foolish confidence—
A disguise, Darkness, and Dreams:
To stir a deaf Apollo <note>original: "Phoebum"</note> from the Delphic cave,
To call the Muses "Divine Beings,"
And to seek the gift of speech (a gift granted by GOD)
From a fountain, a grove, or mountain peaks.
Now another force drives the mind; a greater GOD
Demands other ways of living,
Reclaiming His own gift from man for Himself,
So that we may live for the Father of life:
To be free from vanities, whether in leisure or in business,
And from the literature of fables.

He forbids it, so that we may obey His laws,
And behold His own LIGHT,
Though the clever art of the Sages <note>original: "Sophorum"; here referring to worldly philosophers whose wisdom lacks divine foundation.</note> and rhetoricians,
And the fictions of the Poets <note>original: "Vatum"; can refer to poets, seers, or prophets; Khunrath suggests their myths cloud divine truth.</note> cloud it over,
They who imbue hearts with falsehoods, and yet more falsehoods,
And only train the tongues,
Offering nothing to grant salvation,
Or that might uncover the truth.
For what of the good or true can they hold,
Who do not hold the head of the highest truth,
God, the kindling <note>original: "fomitem"; literally tinder or fuel, implying God provides the spark that sustains the soul's fire.</note> and the fountain of the good?
Whom no one sees except in Christ.
He is the Light of Truth, the way of the way,

He is the Master of virtue,

How can piety be absent from a Christian?

Of piety, to be a Christian; and of the impious,

Reside in your heart; these spectacles show you
This good end and goal,
By which you can enjoy GOD.

<meta>This page follows the introductory prose that described Christ as the "Sun of Equity" and the "Fountain of Goods." The previous text broke off while discussing the radiance of Christ's light. Here, the text shifts into a formal poetic prayer (Oratio) addressed directly to Christ as the source of both spiritual salvation and the hidden knowledge of the natural world.</meta>

## THEOSOPHICAL PRAYER
### TO THE
# FOUNTAIN OF WISDOM
## CHRIST THE BEST
### AND GREATEST.

### Of the Wise-hearted Christians.

**C**HRIST, make me wise, for you alone are the WISDOM of the Father,
*And he who is wise with you, he is truly wise:*
*For who will give me light in such great darkness,*
*So that I may grasp the sweet path of true salvation?*
*To you I flee, who are the very LIGHT for mortals,*
*Through whom all created things have perceived the day.*
*Give to me the LIGHT OF NATURE <note>original: "NATVRÆ LVMEN"; a central concept in Paracelsian and Theosophical thought, referring to the divine intelligence implanted in the created world which a seeker can learn to "read."</note>, and repel the shadows;*
*Let your Spirit illuminate our hearts.*
*Truly, I confess I am not worthy of such great honor,*
*I am wretched, O Christ, and guilty of many crimes.*
*But yet I trust in your poured-out blood, of which*
*A small drop will purge away my filth.*
*If you give me life, why would you not also give*
*All the benefits of life for us out of your goodness?*
*Nay, even whatever we shall ask from the Father in your name,*
*You say that we shall certainly receive.*
*I seek no profit for myself, I claim no vain praise,*
*You alone shall be both my praise and my profit.*
*But neither should you give riches which I might admire as a miser;*
*All things fall; the world holds no firm wealth.*
*Breathe upon my undertakings, fill my mind with celestial*
*Fires, and take away the heavy shadows from my art <note>original: "arte"; referring to the "Great Art" or Alchemy, which the author views as a spiritual and physical pursuit of God's secrets.</note>.*
*Nothing will be obscure; I shall be led easily into the inner chambers*
*Of Nature, if you, O Christ, show me the way.*
*I myself will bring great rewards of praise and thanks to you:*
*For man has nothing greater that he may return to you.*

<summary>This page contains a poetic prayer addressed to Christ as the ultimate source of Wisdom and the "Light of Nature," asking for divine guidance to uncover the secrets of creation. It establishes the author's pursuit of alchemical and philosophical knowledge as a fundamentally religious endeavor rooted in Christian humility and grace.</summary>
<keywords>Theosophical Prayer, Wisdom of the Father, Light of Nature, purification, Christ as Fountain, inner chambers of Nature, spiritual alchemy, divine light</keywords>

<meta>This page continues the introductory sequence of the "Amphitheatre." The catchword from the previous page was "iu-" (referring to "iuxta" or "iustitiam"), leading into the formal description of the Prologue as a mystical ladder.</meta>

# THIS PRESENT PROLOGUE is likened to a certain LADDER of seven orthodox STEPS for the STUDIES of true WISDOM and the right method of PHILOSOPHIZING.

By this mystical ladder—as **GOD** calls and leads, the **GENIUS** <note>In this context, 'Genius' refers to a guiding spirit or a person's natural divine spark.</note> stimulates, **INTELLECT** cooperates, and due, diligent **LABOR** completes—a **THEOSOPHIC** <note>original: "THEOSOPHICVS"; a term for wisdom derived directly from God.</note> ascent is made. This ascent follows the true **WISDOM** and the doctrine of the Wise Man <note>A reference to Solomon, considered the author of the biblical Book of Wisdom.</note> (according to the most favorable judgment of **JEHOVAH** himself). It leads to the **GATE** of the aforementioned **AMPHITHEATRE**, which, though narrow, small, and despised, is nevertheless sufficiently grand and majestic. **IN** and **THROUGH** this gate, any faithful son of **DOCTRINE**, persevering constantly to the end, shall joyfully **ENTER**. There, he will happily **ATTAIN** and—as if it were a singular treasure and storehouse <note>original Greek: "κειμηλίῳ καὶ θησαυρῷ" (keimēliō kai thēsurō).</note>—theosophically **ENJOY** that most universal, triune **SUPREME GOOD**:

*   **First**, the Acknowledgment of **GOD** and of <term>IHSVH CHRIST</term> <gloss>Khunrath uses this specific spelling (the Pentagrammaton) to represent the name of Jesus with the Hebrew letter Shin inserted, symbolizing the Word made flesh.</gloss> whom He sent, and the genuine understanding of the Book of Holy Scripture.
*   **Second**, the knowledge of **HIMSELF**.
*   **Third**, the knowledge of the **GREATER WORLD** <note>The Macrocosm or the universe.</note> and its **SON** which He gave: the <term>MAGNESIA</term> <gloss>In alchemy, "Magnesia" is not the modern chemical element but a symbolic "magnet" or "first matter" capable of attracting divine virtue to create the Philosopher's Stone.</gloss> of the Philosophers, the **STONE** of the Philosophers—universal, more than perfect, a fitting and perfect **SUBJECT** to be made more than perfect by Physical Regeneration with the help of the Chemical Art.

This attainment occurs: **first**, in and **FROM GOD**, and <term>IHSVH CHRIST</term> whom He sent, and the Book of Holy Scripture; **second**, in and from **HIMSELF**; and **third**, finally, in and from the **GREATER WORLD** and its **SON**, the **MAGNESIA** of the Wise, which is **ALL in ALL**. (For this reason, man was composed as a triune being of Body, Spirit, and Soul by the Triune **LORD GOD** <note>original Hebrew: "יהוה ELOHIM" (YHWH Elohim).</note> and was placed principally in this worldly Paradise).

Furthermore, this **PROLOGUE CONSISTS** of as many **VERSES** as there are days in the Year: namely, three hundred and sixty-five. This is so that every single day throughout the whole year, **ONE** verse may be most sharply weighed in the scale of accurate contemplation, considered with an industrious mind, and frequently searched out by the student of genuine **WISDOM** <note>original: "SOPHIÆ".</note>. Thus, this food of the healthy **THEOSOPHIC DOCTRINE** may be converted more suitably and happily into the sweet recreation and most effective nourishment of the Soul. 

In this way—over the space of an entire year (for this is not the work or study of a single day, week, or month, especially for the newly initiated; believe one who speaks the truth and is taught by Experience!)—and indeed with the help and assistance of the <term>RVACH CHOCHMAH-EL</term> <gloss>Hebrew for "Spirit of the Wisdom of God."</gloss>, or the **SPIRIT OF THE WISDOM OF GOD** sent from the Father of **LIGHTS**, the student may be able not merely to taste superficially or with the tip of the lips, but to truly and **QUINT-ESSENTIALLY** perceive. By swallowing deeply and repeatedly, as if tasting again, he may discover **WHAT**, of what **KIND**, how **GREAT**, and how **SWEET** both true **WISDOM** and this method of sincere **PHILOSOPHIZING** are, and what its **DOCTRINE** finally cherishes in its innermost recesses.

Truly, no one will easily or worthily taste these sumptuously prepared and most elegant—indeed, **THEOSOPHICAL**—feasts, much less will they be [pleasing] to any...

<summary>The author describes the Prologue as a 365-verse "ladder" requiring a full year of daily meditation to achieve three-fold knowledge: of God, of oneself, and of the alchemical Macrocosm. This process leads the seeker to the "Magnesia of the Philosophers" and the narrow gate of Divine Wisdom.</summary>

...they will taste most pleasantly, unless first, by sufficient reverberation and tribulation through the *Fire of the cross* <note>original: "Ignem crucis"; this refers to the alchemical and spiritual process of purification through suffering and trial.</note>, they are rightly broken, led from hardness to softness, and—by such vexation which grants understanding—extraordinarily well-exercised. They must also be washed in a Christian manner by the *Water* of penitential tears from impurity to cleanliness and radiance; and, in the Philosophical manner, they must have clearly set aside the vanities of this unclean World, leaving them far behind. Only through this method is one rendered spiritual, well-prepared, and properly disposed for this banquet. Wherefore, such a person—having been frequently tested, sharply examined, most exactly proven, and finally found sufficiently upright and constant—is legitimately received into the number of the Sons and faithful followers of the DOCTRINE of WISDOM itself. THE SUMMARY of this seven-stepped introductory LADDER now follows.

### SUMMARY
### OF THE FIRST STEP.

**T**HE FIRST STEP is for the Wise man—as a true and perfect *Theosopher*, a magnificent and Royal herald of the ETERNAL and only true WISDOM, divinely appointed and delegated—to faithfully **Hear** <note>original: "Audire"; the first step is the act of receptive listening.</note> both that WISDOM itself and those who call and earnestly invite all humanity, every single person, out of a singular and burning affection for the human race. He must hear them eagerly and gladly <note>original German: "schnell vnd gerne/mit lust vnd frewden"</note> as they lead him toward the Love, Admiration, and study of the <term>DIVINE MAGIC</term> <gloss>original Greek: "ΜΑΓΕΙΑΣ (ΣΟΦΙΑΣ)"; here "Magic" refers to the highest "Wisdom," the understanding of the secret workings of God in nature, not sorcery.</gloss> of DIVINE WISDOM—that is, the only legitimate and true, more holy *Theosophical Philosophy*. And, because of the weighty reasons brought forth by both sides, he should habitually obey them without contradiction, reverently <note>original German: "mit Ehrerbietung vnd andacht"</note> like a disciple being first initiated.

---

### SUMMARY
### OF THE SECOND STEP.

**S**ECOND STEP is, after having received this Divine seed (by the calling of the <term>DIVINE ELOHIM</term> <gloss>A Hebrew name for God, emphasizing His power as Creator and Judge.</gloss> and the drawing of GOD, the Father of Lights), to constantly **persevere** in such a happily begun Obedience, not resisting against one's conscience. It is to seek the ETERNAL WISDOM—the only true source, fountain, and one eternal, universal foundation of all truth, virtue, good Wisdom, and true Knowledge and Understanding, both in the matter of Religion and in all Sciences and Arts most useful to the human race, as well as in *orthodox Philosophy*. Consequently, one must seek her as the mother of *Theosophical Philosophy* (which is truly sacred, the only legitimate and true one) with the whole Heart, the whole Soul, all one's strength, and the whole mind—according to the gift kindly granted and communicated from above to each person—from a total offering...

...and by its own tradition, to *love* from a thoroughly internal reasoning; and to ardently *continue* this pursuit. But as for that ^a human, ^b carnal, ^c worldly, counterfeit, and imaginary—or, as it were, "wisdom"—which is ^d puffed up with lofty speeches, sophisticated and persuasive words, ^e and skill in speaking (that is, those fake colors of the oratorical faculty and ambitious Eloquence, from which, by Divine command, the Apostle PAUL faithfully warns us), and which is proud in its rivalry with TRUE DIVINE WISDOM, haughtily exalting itself, and ^f deceiving by the probability of its speech through false reasoning; which is diabolically born and most ruinously propagated and spread by its admirers, who are its own instruments (resembling itself); which is spurious and illegitimate—indeed, profane—the mother of darkness, vices, errors, seduction, and all confusion, and of that false *Philosophy* (named ^h *empty fallacy* or *deception* by that chosen vessel of the LORD, ^g who was conscious of the third heaven and the mysteries of Paradise); this "wisdom," which true WISDOM herself and her Royal herald <note>Likely referring to King Solomon, traditionally the author of the Wisdom books of the Bible.</note> beautifully depict here in their true colors (as if they were *skubala* <note>original: "σκύβαλα"; a Greek term used by St. Paul meaning "dung," "refuse," or "rubbish."</note> fit only for swine): one must *completely leave it behind*, distancing oneself from it by the greatest intervals. One must also, with tireless diligence, call away and discourage others from its cult as much as possible, lest they embrace or follow it in the slightest; so that they may begin to *hate* in good time that which they must now and forever flee.

### ARGUMENT
### OF THE THIRD STEP.

**THE THIRD STEP** is, by the grace of JEHOVAH, *to know and understand What, What sort, how Beautiful, Distinguished & Excellent, and how Great a Matter* <term>ETERNAL WISDOM</term> is. She alone is true; she is the only root, foundation, and the unique, sole, universal, and eternal beginning of a more sincere, healthier, and truer <term>Philosophy</term>—indeed, of the whole of **THEOSOPHY** <note>literally "God-wisdom"; a direct, mystical knowledge of divine things</note> and the right method of *philosophizing*. Furthermore, what exactly is the nature of the aforementioned <term>true PHILOSOPHY</term>?

---

### ARGUMENT
### OF THE FOURTH STEP.

**THE FOURTH STEP** is *to know who* gives true WISDOM; with which Teacher or Master, or *where she is to be sought and found*; *from where she comes*; *in which Books she is handed down*; and *in how many ways* she has manifested herself from the beginning to all creatures, especially to Humans. And how, even today, she offers herself to be seen everywhere and innumerably in both the *Macrocosm* <note>the "great world" or the universe at large</note> and the *Microcosm* <note>the "little world," referring to the human being as a reflection of the universe</note>, just as she evidently *appears* in the <term>Holy BIBLES</term> (especially to those who are truly illuminated by the rays of WISDOM of the DIVINE SPIRIT through a non-feigned *Enthusiasm* <note>original: "Enthusiasmo"; in this context, it refers to genuine divine inspiration or being "filled with God."</note>).

<summary>This page contrasts "carnal" human sophistry with "Eternal Wisdom," urging the seeker to despise the former as rubbish. It introduces the Third and Fourth Steps of the ladder: defining true Theosophy and identifying the sources of Wisdom in the universe, the self, and the Scriptures.</summary>

->FIRST STEP<-

***

## THE ARGUMENT OF THE FIFTH STEP.

The **FIFTH STEP** is to know to whom true **WISDOM** is given, and to whom it is not: *Who is her genuine, legitimate, and faithful student*—namely, the orthodox *Theo-philosopher* <note>A "Theo-philosopher" is one who combines the study of God (theology) with the study of nature and reason (philosophy).</note>: *Who* is a Sophist <note>In this context, a "Sophist" is someone who uses clever but fallacious and deceptive reasoning for personal gain rather than seeking truth.</note>: *How*, or by *what study*, or by *what method* she is to be sought: *How* she comes and is communicated: *By what aids* or *means*; *When* and *in how many ways* she may, should, or can be obtained and perceived (**JEHOVAH** <note>The Hebrew name for God, frequently used in this period to emphasize the biblical foundation of the author's philosophy.</note> fostering and granting his approval): *Whether*, and finally, *What* should be revealed regarding the higher Secrets of this purer Philosophy, which have been obtained through Divine favor; by *Whom*; to *Whom*; *Why*, or for what grave causes; *How much*; under *what Laws* or *Conditions*; *In what manner*; *Where* and *When*, without danger, should they be proposed, spoken, taught, revealed, or further communicated?

***

## THE ARGUMENT OF THE SIXTH STEP.

The **SIXTH STEP** is to know what the *Benefits* and *Gifts* of true **WISDOM** are, and *What the Exercises of the study of Wisdom*—that is, of *true Philosophy*—consist of: *What is its Use, Abuse, Fruit*, and *Purpose*: and *How many* and how various are the *Treasures* that certainly reach the *children of doctrine* <note>A term for dedicated students or disciples of this spiritual philosophy.</note>, immediately and according to the will of **JEHOVAH**.

***

## THE ARGUMENT OF THE SEVENTH AND FINAL STEP.

<margin>The end of all Sophists, certainly, will be tragic because of their contempt for the truth; if not in this life, then surely in the final judgment: to which all those who see the truth being attacked, and who are oppressed because of it, appeal.</margin>
The **SEVENTH** and final Step is *not to care a whit* <note>Original: "Negry morari," using the Greek 'gry' to signify the smallest possible thing.</note> for any Sophists, of whatever sort they may be, who love vanity and seek after lies (<note>original German: "Die das Eitele so lieb haben / vnd die Lügen so gerne."</note>), and who spitefully bite at the **TRUTH**; indeed, for those who frivolously despise and condemn the only true **WISDOM**, and the only right *Theosophical* and orthodox way or method of *philosophizing* that arises from it—as presented in this **AMPHITHEATRE OF ETERNAL WISDOM** <note>This refers to the title of the author's work, Heinrich Khunrath's "Amphitheatrum Sapientiae Aeternae."</note>—as well as its faithful lovers, followers, and the pious seekers of **TRUTH** and **WISDOM**: Rather, it is to look down upon them all with a great and truly philosophical spirit, and to fearlessly value them at less than a single breath; and to eagerly *prepare* and *compose oneself* for the philosophical confession and defense of the recognized **TRUTH** (according to the grace given to each by **GOD** as a gift); and thus at last to usefully *propagate* it to posterity, and to communicate it to them as is due: indeed, to *rejoice* with thanksgiving that one is no longer a labyrinthine, one-eyed, and blinking sophist dealing in opinions, but (being guided by **ETERNAL WISDOM & TRUTH**) a true and knowledgeable **PHILOSOPHER** who exists upon the straight line of *Truth*, walking without any deviation; and thus, finally, to please the very few who are *Theosophically* learned, and who alone see and know the universal **TRUTH**. Which, indeed, is a sign of **TRUTH** that should by no means be looked down upon.

<vocab>Wisdom, Theo-philosopher, Sophist, Amphitheatre of Eternal Wisdom, Philosophy, JEHOVAH, Step</vocab>

### EXPLANATIONS.

**H**EAR.] With the ears of reason, intellect, and mind, as much as those of the senses or the body: lest you be found in the number of those who have ears and hear not, and eyes and see not, whom the blind, malicious pride of the prince of this unclean World has rendered somewhat deaf, mute, and blind. *Son*] A "Son" is to the Hebrews just as a HUMAN or a MAN is to the Latins: hence, when the wise King addresses everyone, he uses this universal <note>original: "Catholica," meaning universal or general</note> term. For WISDOM calls out to all, Proverbs 8, verse 4 and 9, 4. This Wisdom made manifest <note>original: "incarnata" or incarnate</note> says: *Come to me, all you who labor and are burdened: I will refresh you.* Preeminently <note>original Greek: "κατ' εξοχην" (kat' exochen), meaning by way of excellence or especially</note>; that is, according to excellence, a "Son"—namely of DOCTRINE, DISCIPLINE, and ETERNAL WISDOM—is understood to be a faithful and beloved heir. *Magnificent herald*] Because he is a King, the son of a King, and illuminated, taught, and led by JEHOVAH HIMSELF, by the DIVINE SPIRIT OF WISDOM (1 Kings 3). He is one who must be believed above all, as one experienced, and also wisely chosen and appointed for this purpose by SUPER-CELESTIAL WISDOM <note>original: "SOPHIA SVPERCELESTI"</note>. *For knowing* WISDOM, etc.] All these things, of which an enumeration is made in this place, are Good and

<header>EXPLANATIONS</header>

Gifts are from **GOD** the Merciful and Kind, who out of His pure Goodness bestows them in various ways through the holy Spirit of **WISDOM**, that is, either mediately <note>Through secondary causes or teachers</note> or immediately <note>Directly from God to the soul</note>, according to the time and place—as He sees fit to contribute to the glory of His divine name, and to benefit those (and their neighbors) to whom He distributes or gives the gift. Nor does **GOD** give all things to one person; rather, these things are communicated to the "sons of doctrine"—that is, the more faithful who are endowed with skill—and to certain chosen ones (who are few), giving them the better, more secret, certain, and select things as is appropriate. Whence *Lilium* <note>Likely a reference to an alchemical or mystical author, possibly from the work "The Lily among Thorns"</note>, speaking of the Philosopher’s Stone, says: *“If,” he says, “GOD knew a faithful mind in a man, He would certainly impart the truth to him.”* <note>original: "Si, inquit, DEUS sciret in homine mentem fidelem, vtique ei veritatem intimaret."</note>

Therefore, be in the Fear of **GOD** (clothed in the **TEN** Christian-Kabbalistic <term>Kabbalah: a Jewish mystical tradition involving the symbolic interpretation of the Bible and the nature of the Divine</term> garments noted in the second figure of this Greatness), by rejecting the Binary and the Ternary <note>In Pythagorean and mystical number theory, these represent division and the material world</note> and, through the Quaternary <note>The number four, often representing the material world or the Name of God</note>, reducing them as much as your divinely granted strength allows to the simplicity of the Monad <note>The number one, representing the indivisible Divine Source</note>. Seeking the Kingdom of **GOD** and His Justice with your whole heart, whole soul, whole strength, and whole mind—or at least striving to seek it theosophically <term>Theosophy: "Divine Wisdom," or knowledge of God obtained through spiritual intuition</term>—**JEHOVAH** does not reject your will: for in good things, it is enough to have willed well by the instinct of the Best One.

*It is something to advance this far, even if it is not granted to go further* <note>original: "Est aliquid prodire tenus, si non datur ultra," a quote from the Roman poet Horace</note>; *and though strength is lacking, yet the will is to be praised.* <note>original: "Cumq; desint vires, tamen est laudanda voluntas."</note> Obedience well pleases God. <note>original German: "Gott gefällt der gehorsam wol."</note> Nor is **GOD** accustomed, as St. Paul testifies, to extinguish a glowing wick. <note>A reference to 1 Thessalonians 5:19 or Matthew 12:20, meaning God does not destroy a flickering faith</note> If your goal is the glory of **GOD** and "fie" <note>An expression of disgust or rejection</note> to the devil, and if it benefits you and your neighbor (for there is a reason for why, to whom, when, and how much), then by ascending through the Ladder of Conjunction and Union, as well as descending through the Ten Steps of Knowledge, you will happily obtain what you seek from **JEHOVAH** by Praying and Working <note>original: "Orando & Laborando," a reference to the Benedictine motto 'Ora et Labora'</note>; indeed, you will be able to ascend from the bottom to the summit to the knowledge of **ALL THINGS** that truly exist, whether by sense, science, or faith. For the **LORD** will (nothing is more certain) fulfill your will, you who fear Him (Psalm 145:19, see also verses 169 and 334).

Therefore, let all doubt (a concept of the devil within you) depart from you: laboring wisely, believe **GOD** and in **GOD** with firm confidence; by not hesitating in faith, you will find what you seek; it will be given to you; you will receive it; it shall be done. O, the beast of unbelief! Pray to **GOD** that He may increase your faith. Faith is the Gift of **GOD**. *Do not take this from me, I beseech you, Lord!*

### THE FIRST DEGREE.

<margin>3</margin>

| ☞ That shrewdness be given to the little ones, to the youth KNOWLEDGE & UNDERSTANDING. | <margin>Verse 4.</margin> | *To give cleverness to the simple, to the boy KNOWLEDGE & THOUGHT.* |
<margin>3</margin>

*That shrewdness be given to the little ones*] He calls the "little ones" here (just as in verse 39) the "simple"; those who cannot find a way out of their troubles through their own plans, and therefore look for help from the **LORD** and the Helping **WISDOM OF GOD**. These are people who are not "wise in their own eyes" (Proverbs 3:7), unlike the "wise of this world" (Romans 12:16). For **GOD** hides His Wisdom from such people, a fact for which our Savior gave thanks to His heavenly Father in Matthew 11:25: *You have revealed these things,* He said, *to little ones.* <note>original: "Parvulis, inquit, revelasti hæc."</note> *Shrewdness* <note>original: "Astutia"</note>] Shrewdness here signifies circumspection and caution, so that we are not captured and led astray by the deceits of the world; rather, we should be "wise as serpents, and simple as doves" (Matthew 10:16). *This means* (as Saint Paul interprets it in Romans 16:19), *wise in what is good, and simple in what is evil*. Understand, therefore, O little ones, Shrewdness; and you foolish ones, take notice. *Knowledge, etc.*] Knowledge and thoughts are joined here so that we may learn to meditate; through meditation to track down knowledge, through tracking to pray to **GOD**, and through praying to work.

<margin>4</margin>
| | | |
|:---|:---:|:---|
| The Wise man will hear and will add Learning, and the intelligent man will possess counsels. | <margin>Verse 5.</margin> | *Hearing, the Wise man ☞ will be wiser: and the intelligent man will possess the rudders of guidance.* |
<margin>4</margin>

*He will be wiser*] For just as a later day is the teacher of the day before, so a wise man learns from another wise man. There are degrees among the "sons of Doctrine"; one excels another, yet none of them should be despised. *Praise the great fields; cultivate the small ones*; as Virgil <note>A famous Roman poet; this quote is from his work on farming, the *Georgics*</note> rightly advised. It is as if Solomon were saying: one endowed with intelligence, who keeps my commandments, will acquire not only the common arts but also the more secret and hidden ones, and thus he will be wiser. Then, strengthened and powerful in judgment, wisdom, and experience, he will attain ingenious counsels and subtle inventions from day to day in every branch of knowledge, <term>TheoSophically</term> <note>Theosophically: searching for divine or spiritual knowledge through direct experience or "God-wisdom"</note>. However, those who devote themselves to **WISDOM** must receive **HER** from a Wiser one—from the **ALL-WISE GOD**—by praying <term>TheoSophically</term> and working <term>PhysicoChemically</term> <note>Physico-chemically: a term used by early scientists and alchemists to describe working with the laws of nature and the laboratory</note>. *Counsel*] This is the rationale for things to be done, always looking toward **GOD**, toward Mankind, and toward oneself. This is received from the Divine through prayer, so that a healthy outcome may follow.

*Parables*] No one will understand hidden speeches full of mysteries and concealed things, unless the **WISDOM OF GOD** reveals them.

<meta>This page continues the exposition of the Book of Proverbs, moving from the basic purpose of wisdom to the deeper, "mystical" methods of interpreting sacred and natural secrets. # INTERPRETATIONS

It is read that the Queen of Sheba tested Solomon with such things <note>referring to riddles or parables</note>. Joseph the Patriarch and David, the Royal Prophet, were divinely instructed in these matters. The Prophets and the *Revelation of John* <note>The Book of Revelation/Apocalypse</note> contain many such things. The Egyptians were famous for these, as they hid their mysteries in hieroglyphic marks. From this source come those mystical images with which the Magi, through admirable skill, depicted Divine, Theological, Political, and Natural mysteries, as well as the hidden nature of things. From here also come those Hermetic **Emerald Tablets**, the riddles, and the famous pictures of the **Philosopher's Stone**. Learn here (you who thirst for the nectar of truth from the wrappings of the Wise) the way and method of arriving at an understanding of the riddles, parables, allegories, and mystical speeches of the ancient Sages in things Kabbalistic, Magical, and Chemical; in **ALL** things. If you have **WISDOM** as your sister and **PRUDENCE** as your friend (as in verse 106), you will understand and learn **ALL** things theosophically. [*Interpretation.*] The measure, as the Hebrews say, and the weight of the word. To this belongs the Kabbalists' <term>Gematria</term> <note>a method of interpreting words by the numerical value of their letters</note>; <term>Temurah</term> <note>original: "Teuorasche"; the practice of rearranging letters to find hidden meanings</note>; and <term>Notarikon</term> <note>original: "Neoteriken"; a system of creating acronyms or shorthand from words</note>. Or (as John Dee of London expresses it in his *Aphorisms* to the Parisians and in the Preface to King Maximilian prefixed to his *Hieroglyphic Monad*): <term>Geometry</term>, <term>Notarikon</term>, and <term>Tzeruf</term> <note>original: "Tzyraph"; a method of combining letters</note>. And indeed, from the "signature" of things, he calls the former **Real Kabbalah**, or **that which truly exists** <note>original: "ὄντως"</note>; while he calls the latter the common **Grammatical Kabbalah**, or **that which is spoken** <note>original: "λεγομένην"</note>, which relies on the well-known letters that can be written by man. Here it is pleasing to add the verses that the most illustrious man Johannes Olearius, Doctor of Theology and Professor of the Hebrew Language at the famous Julius Academy, wrote twenty-seven years ago in praise of the Kabbalah to Paul of Prague:

->*No dot, no iota of the law shall perish,*<-
->*No letter written by the Prophet's pen.*<-
->*Christ the author asserted this. Who could believe*<-
->*So much weight lies in such tiny marks:*<-
->*Look, Christian Rabbi, at the name of JESUS*<-
->*Dug out from Hebrew fountains, and you will be certain.*<-
->*Believe indeed that nothing in the whole Kabbalah*<-
->*Is found more beautiful, or more sweet to pious souls.*<-
->*Therefore favor this holy study, and so that this Paul*<-
->*May offer more mysteries to Christ, add your prayers.*<-

***

<margin>Proverbs, verse 10.</margin>
> Hear, my son, and receive my sayings, and ☞ the years of your life shall be multiplied.
>
> <gloss>Hear, my son, and receive my words, so that the years of your life may be multiplied.</gloss>

*Multiplied.*] By means of **PHYSICAL-CHEMISTRY** <note>original: "PHYSICOCHEMIA"; a term for alchemy or laboratory science guided by natural laws</note> (which is the faithful handmaid of true **WISDOM** in this age, and a sort of chambermaid for natural secrets), the **LADY** <note>Wisdom</note> kindly bestows upon the industrious son of Discipline the precious essences and most healthfully effective subtleties of Plants, Animals (and their parts), Minerals, Stones, Gems, Pearls, and Metals. Indeed, she even bestows the **PHILOSOPHER'S STONE**, the truest **Universal Medicine** <note>original: "Medicinam Catholicam"</note> for our restoration and preservation. From the legitimate medical use of these things comes length of days. Proverbs 3:2 and Chapter 9, verse 11.

*Running.*] In the stadium or racecourse of your whole life; both in the active and the contemplative life. *You shall not have [a stumbling block], etc.*] Nor will you be led astray, through philosophy and empty deceit, from the center of Theosophical truth to the slippery circumference of worldly sophistries or diabolical lies. # INTERPRETATIONS

->### INTERPRETATIONS<-

*I myself am also a mortal man.*] <note>original: "Sum quidem & Ego mortalis homo," a reference to the Book of Wisdom 7:1</note> Someone might say: Why would GOD reveal his mysteries; why would he communicate the secrets of Nature to me? To me? Who am I? Am I not a sinner, and for that reason mortal? And, consequently, unworthy of such Great Goods and Gifts of GOD—that is, the infinite treasures of ETERNAL WISDOM, which are mentioned in this Prologue. I indeed confess, I respond to such people, that I am unworthy, and yet I am in need. <note>The author uses a wordplay here: "indignus" (unworthy) and "indigus" (in need or lacking).</note> Listen to the Wise King [Solomon], who, though not yet walking perfectly in the precepts of his father David (for he sacrificed in the high places and burned incense), yet in a single night's dream, was filled by GOD with the Wisdom of all things above and below. 1 Kings 3. <note>original: "3. Reg. 3." refers to the Third Book of Kings in the Vulgate, which is 1 Kings in modern Bibles.</note> Together with such prudence in conducting affairs that no one stood as his equal: *I am,* he said, *also a mortal man, like all others,* etc.

Such also (I continue) was Bezalel; nonetheless filled with the Spirit of GOD. In Wisdom, Understanding, and Knowledge in every craft, for devising whatever could be fashioned from gold and silver, bronze, marble, gems, and various types of wood: to whom Oholiab was given as a companion; and WISDOM was placed in the heart of every learned person by the LORD, so they might do all things which Moses commanded, Exodus 31:3. Such also was David, who, although he had not learned letters, yet by the anointing of the Spirit of GOD, was transformed from a shepherd into a Prophet and a preeminent Teacher of Divine matters; with which he so filled his Psalms that all poets, however exquisite, fall far behind him. He was a sinner, an adulterer, a murderer: and yet he did not lose the name of a just man, as often as he rose again through repentance. Elijah, says James 5:17 (timely meeting the present objection), <term>was a man SIMILAR TO US</term> <note>original: "homo erat SIMILIS NOBIS," meaning having the same human nature and weaknesses</note> (the Apostle by no means exempting himself from the common lot), subject to passions: and he prayed with prayer that it might not rain upon the earth, and it did not rain for three years and six months. And again he prayed, and the heaven gave rain, and the earth its fruit. Thus far he [James]. 

You might persist in objecting: "Do not, friend, compare yourself to these; GOD used these singular instruments in a singular way for singular purposes: considering their callings and yours are different, you yourself will judge differently."

There is something, I respond, good man, in what you say: and indeed it would have deterred me, had there not stood in the way—both of WISDOM herself and of the Wise Man—so many, such, and so great universal callings, invitations, warnings, and exhortations; indeed, even threats under the heaviest penalty of Divine wrath, everywhere in this Prologue, calling me back: and if the Universal Promise of Eternal TRUTH did not stand firm and revive me; inviting all, excluding no one, so often repeated, and noted a little further on. <note>The author uses "Catholic" in its original sense of "universal" or "general."</note> I believe this one truthful [Truth] more than your deceptive wagon-load of doubts. Therefore, I will wisely follow WISDOM and the Wise Man as they call, Divinely stimulating me to experience Divine things. Why should I exclude myself, if I am not excluded by GOD? 

Again, someone might doubt, saying: "I am young, I have not yet grown gray." I counter: GOD is no respecter of persons, etc. (verses 38, 184, 299). Nor does a learned old age pleasing to GOD consist solely in a multitude of years, but, etc., as in verse 351. Let there also be for you a consolation and example in the youth of Joseph, David, Solomon, Daniel, Jeremiah, Timothy, etc., and of countless others (even in our own century); not foolish men, but (by the grace of GOD) possessors of the inexhaustible treasures of WISDOM. The same response applies to the objection of a lack or deficiency in various languages—for instance, Hebrew, Greek, Latin, etc. For GOD is accustomed to also rouse...

# FIRST STEP

->### THE FIRST STEP<-

> *The Spirit of the Lord spoke through me, says David*, 2 Samuel 23:2, *and his word was on my tongue.*

Holy men of **GOD** spoke as they were inspired by the Holy Spirit, 2 Peter 1:21. There is no reason, therefore, for you to distrust the grace of **GOD**, whose mercy is from eternity to eternity upon those who fear him, Psalm 103:17. Those trivial excuses cannot protect your laziness and lack of trust, verses 216 and 324. Good **GOD**, how long a catalog I could recite from the ancients (not even excluding the Pagans) regarding inventors of the Sciences and Arts, among whom the greatest part were ignorant of various languages; and in our own century, of those who restored and cultivated them, all divinely stirred and guided by God as teachers of divine wisdom <note>original: "Theosophiceq; doctorum & ductorum," referring to those led by theosophy or divine knowledge</note>, were it not for the "Law of the Preface" <note>An idiom suggesting the need to keep the introduction brief.</note> restraining my pen. 

All these, I say, were mortals, just as I, you, and we all are; even more, they were sinners. Today we have the same **GOD** whom they had then: We are the handiwork of the one and same **ELOHIM** <term>Elohim: A Hebrew name for God, emphasizing His role as Creator and Judge</term> the Creator (in whose image and likeness we were all formed). We make use of the same good Spirits (since **GOD** sends them) for ministry, consolation, defense, guardianship, and direction in our ways. We enjoy the same Nature in the same World. The same most truthful **PROMISE** of the one and same **ETERNAL WISDOM**—which became incarnate in the fullness of time—is Universal <note>original: "Catholica"</note> and given to us. What is it, you will say, that you boast of so much? In what do you trust so greatly? I answer properly: **WISDOM**, which you have heard would become incarnate and will hear again in this Prologue; this same Wisdom, having become incarnate, is **TRUTH** itself, as John 14:12 says:

And whatever you ask the Father in my name, I will do it, so that the Father may be glorified in the Son. If you ask anything in my name (verse 14), I will do it.*

In Matthew 17:19, the disciples came to **JESUS** <note>original: "IHSVM"</note> in secret and said: "Why could we not cast out that demon?" **JESUS** <note>original: "IHSVH," a mystical five-letter spelling of the name of Jesus often used in Renaissance Christian Kabbalah</note> said to them: **BECAUSE OF YOUR UNBELIEF.** (Indeed, it is the same today!)

In Luke 17:6 the **LORD** said:

> *If you had faith like a grain of mustard seed, you would say to this mulberry tree: "Be uprooted and planted in the sea," and it would obey you.*

Look, there you have it. Let us cry out then with the disciples of **CHRIST** (from the same chapter, verse 5): O **LORD**, increase our faith. Provided that you, who have taken the name of Christ, have learned through theosophical exercise <term>Theosophical exercise: Spiritual or contemplative practice aimed at obtaining direct knowledge of God</term> to ask the Father in the name of **JESUS CHRIST CRUCIFIED**, and to **BELIEVE**, you will be able to do **ALL THINGS**.

But if they are, why—lest I speak too harshly—do you tell such fables? O, you perverse minds! Chapter 11 of the Epistle to the Hebrews stands with me against you. Therefore, let no one despair of attaining the Goods and Gifts of Eternal **WISDOM** theosophically <note>original: "Theo-Sophicè," referring to wisdom gained through divine illumination</note>: the hand of the **LORD** is not shortened for all who call upon Him in faith and truth. I recommend to you the story of the lame man healed through faith in Acts 3.

Now, my brother, contemplate with your eyes and Mind this entire Amphitheater <note>A reference to the author's work, the *Amphitheatrum Sapientiae Aeternae* (Amphitheater of Eternal Wisdom), which used complex circular engravings to map out divine knowledge.</note> of ours; it will teach you to find the Light of **ALL** truth in the eternal light. But the spectator who wishes to reach the center must be illuminated by the Spirit of **WISDOM**. Otherwise, these theosophical matters of ours, though divine, will be as night. I add this: it is blasphemous to want to hide one’s own fundamental laziness (verse 93) and un-Christian lack of trust behind a "Giant-like" excuse <note>Likely an allusion to the "Gigantomachy" or the rebellion of the giants against heaven—a metaphor for human pride and stubbornness.</note> that the Church must be confirmed only by miracles. We have the universal promise of **T R U T H**, given once and for all, Eternal Truth, which does not fail forever: it is your unbelief (as Christ witnesses in Matthew 17:20) that stands in the way of the wonderful Goods and Gifts of **G O D**. The promise of **G O D**, the Best and Greatest, has always been constant, firm, and certain, and shall remain so, strengthened and confirmed by the seal of **G O D** (which is **EMES TRUTH** <term>Emes: From the Hebrew word 'Emet' (אמת), meaning Truth</term>, the first figure of this Amphitheater). Only see to it that you do not, through your own malice and lack of trust, lightly cast off or hinder its operation and effect.

Many of the so-called "Theologians" babble much historical talk about Faith from their pulpits, yet they do not demonstrate the presence of an active power of faith by so much as a tiny atom of effect. These men (I speak not of the good ones) deny by their lives and deeds what they say with their mouths. I know, you yourselves know, and others will witness, that the contrary was done by theologians not to be despised, both in the memory of our fathers and in our own. You ought to work and obtain wondrous and rare things through Faith—not for the sake of confirming the Doctrine of Religion, which I know is already more than sufficiently confirmed (even without your reminder), but (I would have you note this) for the sake of the virtue of Faith (as becomes a Believer, so named from Faith) and for the Christian exercise of the duty of Charity toward a neighbor in need.

Therefore, I would wish that no one believe those men to be truly Theologians—no matter how old they are, no matter how much they are endowed with contentious loquacity—who, being defiled by every kind of vice (pride, hypocrisy, avarice, hatred, envy, drunkenness, and often, under the cover of religion, lechery), follow their animal instincts while neglecting the gift of active Faith and the light of the mind.

*AXIOM: As much as anyone experiences of the Divine, so much Faith he has; as much faith, so much miraculous virtue.*

I mean Faith, not that dead kind mentioned in James 2 (which is no more Faith than the devil is a saint, or a dead man is a man), but the living and active kind described in 2 Peter 1. **IN SHORT**: Believe as a Christian; live theosophically; pray with fasting in Spirit and Truth, according to the Laws and Doctrine of this Amphitheater. I call **GOD** to witness: by working together Wisely, that which you ask as a Christian from **JEHOVAH** (for His honor, for the honest benefit of your needy Neighbor and yourself, and to the shame of the devil) shall come to pass. See verse 335.

| 15 **Therefore, there is one entrance into life for all, and a similar exit.** | Verse 6. | *But there is one entrance into life for all, and the same exit.* |

*A similar exit*] A universal law <note>original: "Lex Catholica." In this context, the author uses "Catholic" in its literal Greek sense of "universal" or "general," referring to a law that applies to all of humanity without exception.</note> imposed on all: to die once. Hebrews 9:27.
<margin>The path of death must be trodden by all: Horace, Odes Book 1.</margin>
Rightly says Cornelius Gallus <note>A Roman poet and contemporary of Virgil</note>:
->*The path of death is the same for all, yet there is not*<-
->*Just one way of life or of destruction for everyone.*<-

Weigh well, therefore, my brother, how this life is more fleeting than smoke; emptier than a shadow. For indeed *the days of our life flee like a shadow*. 1 Chronicles 29:15; Job 8:9 and 14:2; Psalm 109:23 and 144:4; Ecclesiastes 7:1; Wisdom 2:5 and 5:9. *They vanish like smoke*. Psalm 102:4. *They pass more swiftly than a web is cut by a weaver*. Job 7:6. *They are swifter than a runner*. Job 9:25. *They spin away like a spider’s web* <note>original: "meditantur, sicut aranea." A poetic Latin rendering of Psalm 90:9, comparing the fragility or the "plotting" of human life to the intricate but easily destroyed work of a spider.</note>. Psalm 90:9. *They are like a watch in the night*. Psalm 90:4 and 6. *Our life is wind*, Job 7:7, *a vapor appearing for a little while, and then vanishing*. James 4:14. *It passes through like a cloud*. Psalm 7:9. *All flesh is grass, and all its glory is like the flower of the field, blooming in the morning and falling away in the evening*. Isaiah 40:6-7; Job 14:2; Psalm 90:4 and 6; Ecclesiastes 14:18. Considering this fragility of human life on one hand, and the infinite greatness of the Divine Majesty on the other, the Royal Prophet <note>King David</note> is seized with wonder, and as if astonished, bursts forth into this voice: *What is man, that you are mindful of him?* Psalm 8:5. The same thought even wrung tears from Xerxes—that energetic leader and most powerful King—when he once looked down from a lofty and high place upon an infinite multitude of men and an innumerable army; he wept because not one of those he then beheld would still be alive after a hundred years. Therefore, compensate for this brevity of life with goodness and integrity, you who profess yourself a Christian; think not how long you live, but how well. And since nothing is more certain than death, yet nothing more uncertain than the hour of death, learn to die well by living holily in the fear of **GOD**.

*Peace*] Both kinds: the external, which is temporal and worldly; hence the Wise Man says (Proverbs 16:7), "when the ways of a man please the LORD, he will turn even his enemies to peace." And the internal peace of the soul, which is eternal and heavenly, which the incarnate WISDOM, alone and only, gives as a gift, and which the world cannot give in the world. The true method of reaching this peace is if we wage war with ourselves—both physically and spiritually, externally and internally. This occurs if we Christianly reject the <term>BINARY</term> <note>The "Binary" or "Duality" (Latin: Binarium) represents a state of being divided from God, or the conflict between flesh and spirit. In theosophy, "1" is unity with God, while "2" is the fall into division.</note> (as seen in the second figure of this <term>Amphitheater</term> <note>Likely referring to the "Amphitheatrum Sapientiae Aeternae" (Amphitheater of Eternal Wisdom), the famous work by Heinrich Khunrath where this text likely originates.</note>), which means fighting fiercely against our vices and overcoming them through WISDOM. Therefore, since all our life upon earth is a warfare (Job 7:1), "fight the good fight, holding faith and a good conscience" (1 Timothy 1:18–19). Paul describes the weapons of this spiritual battle in Ephesians 6:13 and following. He will win in this contest who has first conquered himself; however, no one will win unless he is an "Israelite" <note>Meaning "one who strives with God," referring to spiritual victory.</note>. See verse 320. Let us call upon JEHOVAH with DAVID (Psalm 144:1), who "teaches our hands for this battle and trains our fingers for war," and who supplies us with the strength to conquer that harmful beast of <term>DUALITY</term> <note>original: "DUALITATIS". Similar to the "Binary," this represents the internal division and worldly temptation that distracts from divine Unity.</note>. True peace of soul consists in JESUS CHRIST alone—who is our peace—and in true faith, which relies on the merit of Christ (Romans 5:1). May the "Peace of GOD, which surpasses all understanding, guard our hearts and minds in Christ Jesus."

Invite **GOD**, so that He may be a familiar companion to you, the author and teacher of all your plans, your labors, and your entire life. Consult the **WISDOM OF GOD** in the <term>Oratory</term> <note>A place dedicated to prayer and meditation</note>, which desires the very best for you; and in the <term>Laboratory</term> <note>The place of physical or chemical work; here Khunrath links spiritual insight with practical experiment</note>, follow His counsels wisely, in both public and secret matters: you will not regret it. For you will experience what it is to be inspired by the Divine; to be moved by the Godhead; to be seized; to be transfigured; and to be taught by the anointing of the Holy Spirit: if first and before all else (as we have said) you approach **JEHOVAH** <term>theosophically</term> <note>From "Theosophy," meaning a direct, mystical knowledge of the divine</note> with religious devotion, with due reverence, and with meditations and soliloquies.

For *day unto day utters speech; one book shall open another, and night unto night shows knowledge.* This is the truly wise way of philosophizing. By this method, the Most High—whose name is **JEHOVAH**, and whose Glory and Majesty fill the Heavens, the Earth, the Sea, and **ALL THINGS**—will show Himself to you in His universal, triple-triune Book of Omnipotence, Mercy, and infinite Goodness. Hallelujah: Hallelujah: Hallelujah. O blessed vision, seeing **ALL THINGS**.

***Awakening.***] First from physical sleep, early in the morning, while still lying in bed: then, from the slumber of sins, once the night of the mind's darkness has been repentantly shaken off, so that the **SUN** of **ALL** truth may rise within you. See verse 160.
