# FROM THE SON OF THE GREATER WORLD, TRIUNE, HERMAPHRODITIC, UNIVERSAL; IN TRIUNE GOVERNANCE; FOR USE AND END, UNIVERSALLY; TRIUNE

<margin>
And of this illustrated [matter], if one is a lover of Theosophy <note>Theosophy here refers to "divine wisdom" or the study of God through nature, a common pursuit for alchemists like Khunrath or Böhme.</note>, that a medicine of both [body and soul] might be given, by the Grace of God.
</margin>

---

-> **THE STONE OF THE PHILOSOPHERS, NATURE EXALTATED** <-
-> **MIRACLE OF THE UNIVERSAL ELIXIR** <-
-> **IN ITS OWN GLORIFIED STATE; VISIBLE SALT AND OIL** <-
-> **THE UNIVERSAL THEOSOPHICAL EARTH, ENCIRCLED, IN WHICH...** <-

---

FROM THESE TWO SOURCES OF NATURE, a great universal friendship, a glutinous, oily & permanent, tenacious, ethereal HEAVEN, the seat of the soul, joined to its own... FIRE is found, this our sincere **SULPHUR**: gathering homogeneous things, separating heterogeneous things <note>This is a classic definition of the alchemical principle of Sulphur as the active, formative fire.</note>, gentle and pure AIR, the universal **MERCURY**, the most limpid dew of the sun, the virgin’s milk <note>A poetic term for the purified mercurial solvent.</note> by constant precipitation and <gloss>philosophic</gloss> whiteness frequent, hastening to subtlety by the hour, fostering, and thinning the fluid and slippery substance, and for easy movements the flying **DRAGON** <note>The "flying dragon" often represents volatile mercury or the spirit that must be "fixed."</note> and the sharp water of the turret, providing fire that does not die, they make the fire of all mixtures with the sub-reddened sparks, returning the flame <term>TREE OF GOD <note>original: "STE DEVDRO," likely a corruption of the Greek "Sten Dendron" or "Theos Dendron," referring to the philosophical tree of life.</note></term>.

**WATER OF LIFE**, not common, but celestial water, and watery fire; the **VOLATILE** part of our Stone rendered bodily from its own salt, naturally, and more solvent than thunder than corrosive water and the common fire. **MERCURY** & **PHILOSOPHIC SULPHUR**. A moist vapor and oily habit, a viscous and fat substance, tempers with a benign mixture the copious coagulation of **SALT** (which is the chief duty of **SULPHUR**). The sharpest **VINEGAR**, and [of the Wise] <note>original: "Sapientum." Philosophers often called their solvent "Acetum Acerrimum" or the sharpest vinegar.</note>: It is also our ethereal little cloud **SPIRIT**, and the **SOUL (SPARK OF THE GREATER WORLD)**. The **UNIVERSAL SOUL**, that is, **UNIVERSAL NATURE** in our sulphur, which is the **ANIMATED SPIRIT**, or Universal, animating and living again its own lifeless body, purged by suitable washing, our **ONE** thing (**BLOOD OF THE EARTH** in which, as it also is in sacred writings, the Soul dwells) red, universal, and many-leaved: transparent and clear, purified **ADAM**, King of the lower region, **SPERM** in the <note>original: "Gabriis," likely referring to Gabricus, the masculine alchemical principle</note> **SOLAR** matters and **SOLAR** matters in their own and <term>philosophic things <note>original: "phil.m"</note></term> above all things washing. And holy **POTABLE GOLD**, our own: away with the filth of the common sort, and of our **GOLD**, collected and purged, and polished, the **ORNAMENT** of its own body.

It emphasizes the spiritual nature of alchemy, linking the physical purification of matter to the "Universal Soul" and the "Spark of the Greater World."</summary>

**IT WILL BEFITTING** us, therefore, having first been piously washed and purgated through repentance, to offer ourselves and, as suppliants with sincere faith, commend ourselves to the Deific Light. This waiting should occur both immediately and through intermediaries, as much while sleeping as while waking. And thus, **DIVINELY**, we are to be kindled; illustrated; illuminated; sanctified; to **Enjoy** Jehovah <note>original: יהוה (the Tetragrammaton)</note>; to **Undergo Divine Things** <note>original: "DIVINA PATI," a mystical term for a passive state where one allows God to act upon the soul.</note>; indeed, to be snatched up ineffably into **GOD**; and as if to be **DEIFIED**. 

In the meantime, we should be praising and adoring (especially in **SOLILOQUIES** <note>Khunrath uses "soliloquies" to mean private, internal prayers or meditative dialogues with the Divine.</note>, and those daily, and for the most part, in the mornings) that immense **SEA OF MERCY** and infinite **OCEAN OF ALL GOODNESS**; from which proceeds not only the operation of the wondrous **WORD** Yahshua <note>original: יהשוה (a Cabalistic form of the name Jesus)</note> **CHRIST CRUCIFIED** <note>original: "ΧΡΙΣΤΟΥ" (Christou)</note>, and of all the sacred names and words of Jehovah <note>original: יהוה </note> (which, as far as we are concerned, are the sensible dwellings of the Divinity, as well as memorials teaching us: also stimulating, aiding, and elevating the appetite of the **Soul and the Mind within us**, an admirable operation, in...

It was also seen by various Princes, Counts, Barons, Nobles, and—nearest to the nobles due to their virtue and learning—Doctors. Indeed, from every nation—Jewish, Gentile, and Christian, even Turkish—and from every rank and order, many people everywhere, both Clergy and Politicians, the learned and the unlearned alike, have seen it with their own eyes (marveling at the miracle of Nature performed through Art) and touched it with their own hands. 3. # THE PHILOSOPHERS' STONE
## I.
### IT IS: For THIS [Stone],

**E**XPERIENCE—the infallible mistress and teacher of all things, even when standing alone—attests to this fact: and to reject her, would it not be more than foolish? This Stone (though prepared by others), in its virtuous efficacy, has been seen by both the **ROMAN PONTIFF** <note>original: "PONTIFEX ROMANVS," referring to the Pope.</note> and His **IMPERIAL MAJESTY** <note>original: "CÆSAREA MAIESTAS," referring to the Holy Roman Emperor.</note>. It has also been seen by various Princes, Counts, Barons, Nobles, and (by virtue of their merit and learning) those closest to the nobility, the Doctors. Indeed, from every nation—Jewish, Heathen, and Christian, and even the Turkish—and from every rank and order, many people everywhere, both Churchmen and Politicians, the literate and the illiterate alike, have seen it with their own eyes (marveling at this miracle of Nature produced through Art) and have touched it with their own hands. I speak as one who knows. # II.
## WHAT IS THE
### PHILOSOPHER'S STONE?

The **PHILOSOPHER'S STONE** is the **SPIRIT OF GOD** <note>Hebrew: *Ruach Elohim*</note> (which hovered over the waters, Genesis 1). It is conceived by the mediation of Heaven (**JEHOVAH** <note>Hebrew: *YHWH*</note> alone so willing out of His pure goodness) and made into a body—real and perceptible to the senses—within the **ancient** <note>Greek: *palaeotikō*</note> womb of the **CHAOS** of the created greater world's virgin: namely, the **EARTH**, empty and void, and the **WATER**. It is born into the light as a son of the **macrocosm** <note>Greek: *makrokosmou*</note>; in appearance (to the foolish) it is vile, deformed, and as if among the least of things. It is, however, <term>consubstantial</term> <note>Having the same substance or essence.</note> and similar to its parent: a small world (imagine nothing for yourself here concerning man, or anything taken from or by him). It is universal, triune, **hermaphrodite** <note>Greek: *hermaphroditos*, representing the union of masculine/sulfur and feminine/mercury principles</note>, visible, and sensible to touch, hearing, smell, and taste; it is local and finite. It is manifested, in a regenerative way, by itself, through the obstetric hand of the physico-chemical art, in its own body, once assumed and glorified. It is for uses and benefits that are almost infinite, wonderfully salvific for both the microcosm and macrocosm in their universal triunity.

Away with you, son of perdition! You are a **type** of the sinner, not of the Savior; you are able and ought to be saved, but you cannot save. You are a figure of the mediator leading to error, ruin, and death—not of that Good One leading to truth, growth, and life. # III.
# WHY IT IS CALLED A STONE,
## AND WHY OF THE PHILOSOPHERS?

Why it is properly called a **S**tone, and what its name is—the name by which it is known among the common people (who are blind with seeing eyes and deaf with hearing ears)—**GOD HIMSELF**, for certain reasons passed down in the writings of the high priests of Wisdom, has strictly forbidden anyone to reveal. For this reason, all philosophers have preferred to die rather than divulge this. For it is, by the just judgment of **GOD**, always has been, and (with **JEHOVAH** <note>The Tetragrammaton (יהוה) in the original Hebrew script; the personal name of God.</note> Himself as a strong and jealous guardian) shall be—along with its solution—the most secret Secret of the **ART**, rightly sealed by the Sages against the unworthy (who are deservedly envied) by a bolt of anathema <note>A formal curse or religious ban</note>.

I will, however, bring forward the philosophers speaking philosophically: because, they say, like that of stones, its generation and regeneration also come from a moist, viscous, and glutinous substance, and a dry earthy one. And: because by its own cooking (which proceeds by thickening), it is hardened into a permanently fixed stone (which, like a stone, may be ground down). <term>Alphidius</term> <note>An ancient alchemical authority often quoted in medieval Latin texts</note>: "If the stone had a proper name, 'stone' would be its name." Others: "a stone which is not a stone." Thus the philosophers speak philosophically. Let a clearer answer remain stored deep in the mind, lest we stir up divine fury against us. The <term>Hidden Stone</term> <note>original: "Lapis occultus"</note> belongs to the **PHILOSOPHERS**, not to the foolish and the ignorant; not to the impious or those who are wicked against their conscience.

Now, as to who a Philosopher is (that is, a <term>lover of true wisdom</term> <note>original: "Sapientiæ veræ amator"</note>), you are perfectly taught in the second part of this *Amphitheater*. I leave you these two axioms to consider, brotherly: "From the end of every intention, its beginning results." And: "When the causes of a thing lie hidden, one proceeds from signs and effects to the investigation of those causes." Be content with these.

# V.
## WHAT IS HEAVEN?

**H**EAVEN is a corporal **E**THEREAL **S**PIRIT, or a spiritual ethereal body, not subject to corruption, permeating the structure of the whole World: above, it is fixed by the **WORD** of the **LORD**, hence it is called the **FIRMAMENT**; below, it is incorporated into the whole sublunary mass. Heaven is one, of one and the same essence and substance—both that which is below and that which is above. That lower part, however, through the skillful labor of **Physico-chemistry** <note>The author uses this term to describe the experimental study of nature’s hidden forces, blending what we now call physics and chemistry with alchemical tradition</note>, can be made manifest to the senses and handled for the use of men.

# VII.
## HOW, AND WHERE WAS THE
## SON OF THE MACROCOSM BORN INTO THE LIGHT?

->*The Son, appearing (in the presence of the foolish) as vile, deformed, and as if among the last of things: of the same substance and similar to the parent, a Small World (not a man), universal, triune, hierarchical <note>original Greek: ἱεραρχικὸς (hierarchikos)</note>: <term>Gold ☉</term>, visible, perceptible by touch, hearing, smell, and taste, localized and finite?*<-

**W**HERE? In the holy, universal earth, which he even now happily inhabits, in the kingdom of Saturn <note>In alchemy, the 'kingdom of Saturn' refers to the initial stage of the work, associated with lead, darkness, and the "prima materia" or raw earth.</note>. THE SON OF THE MACROCOSM <note>original Greek: ΜΑΚΡΟΚΟΣΜΟΥ (Makrokosmou)</note>; formed from the seed and blood of the parent, and naturally brought forth from its womb into the light. VILE IN APPEARANCE (to the foolish), DEFORMED, AND AS IF AMONG THE LAST: a laughingstock to the world; yet in the sight of the Wise man, he is most precious. JESUS CHRIST <note>original: I H S V H C H R I S T V S. The spelling "IHSHVH" adds the Hebrew letter Shin to the Tetragrammaton, a common practice in Christian Kabbalah to represent the Incarnation.</note> required no other archetype in Nature. OF THE SAME SUBSTANCE AND SIMILAR TO THE PARENT: because he is from the seed and substance of the parent. UNIVERSAL: according to body, Spirit, and Soul: even in his virtues and operations.

His SPIRIT is also of a universal condition, as is his SOUL, which is a spark of the universal Soul of the World—Universal, that is, of a Universal Nature, property, and operation. "Universalism" alone holds place here; "particularism" is an absurdity <note>literally a "solecism," an error in logic or grammar</note>. The UNIVERSAL REMEDY <term>Catholicon: a "panacea" or universal medicine sought by alchemists</term> of the Physico-Chemists comes only from that which is universal. For every like thing is produced by its like. And, "As the seed is, so is the sprout." Therefore, let all special or particular matters, of whatever order, name, or virtue they may be, bid farewell and depart far from here (even beyond the Caspian Mountains). A Universal Remedy is required—

In the mixing of these things, purified on the surface or externally according to the weights and proportions of Nature, remember to observe and apply most diligently the triple secret of **Composition**, known to very few; otherwise, the animated spirit cannot be joined to the body, nor, conversely, can the body be reunited to the spirit. When this has been rightly performed, a new **Chaos** of universal Nature will be present, arising from the former one, for the new World to come: it is unfolded and separated: the separated parts are adorned, that is, the Divine parts of the internal, radical, and central Nature: by the labor of hands...

...[of the Microcosm] <note>original: "Mundi minoris"</note>, that is, the Lesser World, who was conceived by the Holy Spirit in the womb of the blessed Virgin; of the unutterable, most innocent **PASSION**, of the **SALUTARY DEATH**, and the honorable **BURIAL**; of the **DESCENT** into hell, full of consolation; of the victorious **RESURRECTION**, with the body assumed within the virginal womb; of the glorious **ASCENSION** into heaven; and finally, of the **SITTING** at the right hand of **GOD** the Almighty. It is the infallible *Proof* of the **FINAL JUDGMENT**, both tremendous, upon the living and the dead, and upon the whole world through fire. It is the most merciful *Example* of the **REMISSION OF SINS** and of liberation from the impurities of darkness. It is the living **IMAGE** of the mystery of the individual union of the **HOLY DIVINE TRINITY**.

---

There are in Nature particular powers to which malignant powers yield; why not also to a universal power? Nor can the author of confusion <note>Satan</note> endure symmetry. In its **INTELLECT** (*in medical use*), it sharpens and nobilitates; thus it also procures a sublime **MEMORY** and **PRUDENCE**. It wonderfully excites perpetual **CHEERFULNESS** (*in the absence of external violence*) and honest **BOLDNESS** (*which is Fortitude of the Soul*). It is the most true, universal **MEDICINE** for our **RESTORATION** and **PRESERVATION**; and, with **GOD** cooperating, it virtuously drives away all **DISEASES**, both external and internal—whether they be of the *body, of the Spirit, or of the Mind*—even those which are *incurable to false physicians* <note>original: "pseudomedicis," meaning quacks or those without true hermetic knowledge</note>. It preserves the whole man (*if previously disposed*) until the end of life predestined for him by **GOD**, keeping him vigorous and strong in both intellect and body.

---

The **PHILOSOPHICAL [WORK]** <note>original: "Philm.", likely referring to the Stone or the Work of the Philosophers</note> reduces **BODIES** to the first matter <note>the <term>Prima Materia</term>, the original, undifferentiated substance of the universe</note> (for the first matter is the universal animated form); and it renders **METALS** (as I myself have seen), **CRYSTAL, GEMS, PEARLS, FLINTS,** and all **STONES** (even those of the Microcosm <note>referring to kidney or bladder stones within the human body</note>), as well as **MINERALS**, truly potable <note>drinkable/liquid</note>. It frees **ANIMALS** from diseases and preserves them in the vigor of their virtue. It brings back to life and refreshes **VEGETATION** that is nearly dead, having been fermented by the specific essence of simples and methodically applied to them; it does this by strengthening their native moisture (the universal moisture remaining) and delivering them (in this instance) from imminent destruction. In a suitable lamp, its permanent water, being skillfully kindled, burns permanently forever. And (to conclude many things in few words) it is miraculously effective upon **ALL** the fruits of the lower globe, as well as upon sublunary spirits. For all these things naturally obey this **STONE** on account of its weighty causes.

## IN SUMMARY.

The **P**HILOSOPHERS' STONE <note>original: "Lapis Phil[osophorum]"</note> is a magnificent Matter, object, and subject of all the wondrous things that are in the Heavens and on the Earth. It is also a most vast and miraculous THEATER of the miracles and secrets of the whole Universe, explaining in a real sense the Books of Holy Scripture and of Nature. From the accurate contemplation of this—as if by a high and lofty step—we ascend <term>Theosophically</term> <note>meaning through divine wisdom or mystical insight</note> into the Recognition of JEHOVAH <note>original: "יהוה", the Hebrew name of God</note>; and we are drawn Naturally and Sensibly into a deeper, true, and perfect knowledge of NATURE and of OURSELVES. For it is an immense sea of the eternal Goodness, Wisdom, and Omnipotence of **GOD**, the Just and Merciful, and a great testimony of His kindness toward us. Behold; you have its USE, universally Triune: **DIVINE**, namely, <term>Microcosmic</term> <note>relating to man as a "little world"</note> and <term>Macrocosmic</term> <note>relating to the universe as a "great world"</note>. These are subdivided into the physical and the physico-medical—truly for all humans, Vegetables, Animals, Minerals, Metals, and all things Aquatic and Subterranean—as well as the physico-magical, hyper-physico-magical, theosophical, and <term>Cabalistic</term> <note>referring to the mystical interpretation of divine secrets</note>.

# CAN THE PHILOSOPHERS' STONE
## (as they say) BE MULTIPLIED?

**I**T CAN. And indeed, both in quality and in quantity. And the **MULTIPLICATION** of the Philosophers' **STONE** is nothing other than the reiteration of the universal Physico-chemical work, with the glorified stone being dissolved again (before fermentation) in its universal fountain—that is, the **AZOTH** <note>a term for the universal solvent or the essential "mercury" of the alchemists</note>—according to the second regime. The more often the work of Multiplication is repeated, the more quickly and perfectly the work is completed in its power; and this continues
->thus unto infinity.<-

# COROLLARIES
### FOUR.

<margin>1</margin>
*The **EXPENSES** for this whole work, completed up to the point of fermentation (excepting food and clothing), do not at most exceed the value of 30 thalers <note>original: "30 talerorum", a silver currency used throughout Europe at the time</note>: I speak as one who knows, having been fraternally taught by one who knows. Those who state otherwise are in error.*

<margin>2</margin>
*Just as a tenth part of worldly goods is usually spent for **GOD**, in pious causes, while nine parts are for worldly use: so, on the contrary, it befits the <term>Theosopher</term> <note>a seeker of divine wisdom</note> to spend only a tenth part of this **Stone** on worldly uses; but the remaining nine parts for **GOD** alone, in one's neighbor who is in need. This is the duty of the almoners of **GOD**, in this great hospital [of the world].*

<margin>3</margin>
*Of **JESUS CHRIST** the crucified, Savior of the whole human race—that is, the **Microcosm** <note>original: "Mundi minoris", the 'lesser world' or man</note>—there is a type in the book of Nature and as if in a mirror: the savior of the **Macrocosm** <note>original: "Mundi maioris", the 'greater world' or the universe</note>, which is the Philosophers' **STONE**. Therefore, from this Stone, recognize **CHRIST** naturally; and from **CHRIST**, learn the Philosophers' **STONE** theosophically: Thus, the pious and religious Antiquity was made more certain of the promised **Messiah** <note>original: "Maschiah"</note>, even from, in, and out of Nature. Thus the Heathen, or the Turk <note>a common 17th-century term for Muslims</note>, who (O God!) esteems Holy Scripture as nothing, can be convinced of the truth from the book of Nature through sense and reason, and (with Divine grace cooperating) be converted to Christianity. So also the Jew.*

<margin>4</margin>
*He who has properly learned the mysteries of Holy Scripture, and also how to read in the book of Nature and in Himself; and vice versa: HE will be a wonderful discoverer of the treasures of Eternal **WISDOM**. For book explains book. This marvelous way of speaking and teaching pleased the marvelous **GOD**: let it please me and you as well. **The Infinite! The Infinite! The Infinite!** <note>original: "Ensoph! Ensoph! Ensoph!", the Hebrew Kabbalistic term for God as the 'Infinite' or 'Endless'</note>*

---

## RIDDLE.

*The **FIRST ALL** in all things handed over to the **THIRD ALL** (from the **FIRST** and **SECOND ALL**) the **FIRST SECOND ALL** in **ALL THINGS**, so that from there he might recognize, know, and possess **ALL THINGS IN ALL**, and **ALL THINGS** (universally). What is his name, if you know it? Hear this counsel: Walk in the ways of the Teaching and Laws of this **Amphitheater**, and **JEHOVAH** <note>original: "יהוה", the four-letter Hebrew name of God</note> will teach **ALL THINGS** in a fatherly way.*

->SIMPLICITY IS THE SEAL OF NATURE AND ART.<-
->I have spoken.<-

## TWO COROLLARIES

1 *The **JESUS CHRIST** of the crucified, Savior of the whole human race—that is, the Minor World <note>The "Microcosm," referring to the human being as a reflection of the universe.</note>—is typed in the book of Nature and as if in a mirror by the savior of the Major World <note>The "Macrocosm," or the universe at large.</note>, which is the **PHILOSOPHER'S STONE**: Therefore, recognize **CHRIST** naturally from this Stone; and from **CHRIST**, learn of the **PHILOSOPHER'S STONE** theosophically. Thus, pious and religious antiquity was made more certain of the promised **MESSIAH** <note>original: "Maschiah"</note> even from, in, and out of Nature. So the Heathen, or the Turk <note>A common early modern term for Muslims.</note>, though esteeming Holy Scripture (**GOD!**) as nothing, can be convinced of the truth from the book of Nature through sense and reason, and (by the cooperation of Divine grace) be converted to Christianity. So also the Jew.*

2 *He who has learned the mysteries of Holy Scripture well, and also how to read in the book of Nature and in himself, and vice versa: he shall be a wonderful discoverer of the treasures of Eternal **WISDOM**. For book explains book. This marvelous way of speaking and teaching has pleased the marvelous **GOD**: let it please me and you likewise. **THE INFINITE! THE INFINITE! THE INFINITE!** <note>original: "Ensoph," a Hebrew Kabbalistic term for the Infinite or the Divine Essence before manifestation.</note>*

**Y**ou have now heard, O mortals, best Spectators, through the royal and most wise herald of SUPER-CELESTIAL WISDOM <note>original: "SOPHIAE SVPERCAELESTIS." Khunrath views Wisdom as a divine entity emanating from God.</note>, and through me, his interpreter and a faithful lover of THEOSOPHY <term>Theosophy: Here, the "wisdom of God," a mystical insight into the divine nature and its relationship to the natural world.</term>—or rather, from the Eternal Wisdom of the Eternal One herself, the only true one—what WISDOM is; of what kind and how great she is; what things are in conflict with her; what Treasures, Uses, Effects, and Fruits she possesses. O that you (by reading the DOCTRINE of the Amphitheater in the Prologue, and by seeing the things of the Prologue in the Amphitheater) had wisely contemplated and rightly understood the Amphitheatrical games and spectacles of TRUE WISDOM, which are Christian-Cabalistic <note>original: "Cabaliſtica." A term Khunrath uses for "Divine Magic" or the study of God's power in nature, distinguishing it from common sorcery.</note>, and Physico-Chemical <note>original: "PhyſicoChemica." This refers to alchemy—the study of nature (physics) through chemical transformation.</note>. O that you yourselves would also faithfully act, exercise, and imitate these things theosophically in your **ORATORIES** & **LABORATORIES**. But I fear that among thousands, there is scarcely one who will. For it does not happen to everyone—believe one who tells the truth—to reach the port of truth; nor is it within everyone’s power to know, in a Biblical, Macrocrosmic, and Microcosmic <note>A worldview where the "Macrocosm" (the great universe) and the "Microcosm" (the small world of man) are mirrors of each other.</note> way within **TRIUNE UNIVERSALISM** <note>original: "CATHOLICISMO TRIVNO." Not referring to the Roman Catholic Church, but to a "universal" system of truth based on the Holy Trinity.</note>, God, and Him whom He sent, JESUS CHRIST, as well as ONESELF, and the greater WORLD, and the spirit He gave...

## EPILOGUE OR CONCLUSION

<margin>
By whom this Amphitheater may be understood; and by whom not.
</margin>

The SON, the MAGNESIA of the Philosophers <term>Magnesia of the Philosophers: In alchemy, this is not the common mineral, but a symbolic "prime matter" or secret substance believed to contain the seeds of all things.</term>. Only those born of the Gods (ELOHIM <note>original: "ELOHIM." A Hebrew name for God. Khunrath often uses Hebrew terms to emphasize the ancient, mystical roots of his philosophy.</note>) were able [to grasp this]: that is, those who (as the figure shows) study from the heart—with the cooperation of Divine Grace—to return the Binary and the Ternary through the Quaternary to the simplicity of the Monad <note>This refers to alchemical numerology where the "Binary" (duality/matter) and "Ternary" (soul/spirit) are unified through the "Quaternary" (the four elements) back into the "Monad" (the perfect divine Unity).</note>. Know that it is not a fool, but a prophet who has told you: he who is not yet washed and purged through penance; he who is not a tireless student of the FIRE <note>Khunrath views Fire as the primary tool of both God and the chemist.</note>, which is the lower part of the Book of NATURE <note>The "Book of Nature" was a popular Renaissance idea that God revealed His wisdom through the physical world as a companion to the Holy Bible.</note> that explains things physically and chemically; he who is not a student of God in the University of this World; he who is not "Universal" in his understanding of the Bible, the Macrocosm, and the Microcosm <term>Macrocosm and Microcosm: The ancient belief that the human being (microcosm) is a miniature map of the entire universe (macrocosm).</term>; he who is not illuminated by the SPIRIT OF WISDOM; he, I say, will hardly taste the marrow and nectar of this Amphitheater. 

What truth could be understood, what solid thing could be known, or what could be fruitfully handled by someone who is impure? Someone who is not piously practiced in the school of the cross and tribulations? Someone who is not physically and chemically "Vulcanian" <note>original: "vulcanicus." Referring to Vulcan, the god of fire; here meaning one who works practically at the alchemical furnace.</note>? A sophist; a false physician; a "bad-doctor" <note>original: "cacomedicus." From the Greek "kakos" (bad) and Latin "medicus" (doctor).</note>; a dweller in labyrinths; one who stays on the surface; a deceptive specialist; a conjurer or a devilish person? Let him who is not a son of this most holy DISCIPLINE and DOCTRINE depart, and let him learn **Theosophically** <term>Theosophically: Derived from "God" and "Wisdom," meaning a way of thinking that combines divine revelation with natural observation.</term> before he passes judgment on this Amphitheater.

<margin>
What kind of Reader, Listener, Contemplator, and Judge is required here.
</margin>

I ask for a Reader, I want a Listener, I desire a Contemplator, I require a Judge who is practiced in **TheoSophics, Physics, Physico-Medicine, Physico-Chemistry, Physico-Magic, Hyper-physico-Magic,** and the **Cabala** <term>Cabala: A form of Jewish mysticism that Khunrath adapted into a "Christian Cabala" to find hidden meanings in the Bible and nature.</term>; one who is practiced in the Bible, the Macrocosm, and the Microcosm; one who is Orthodox and Universal; one who is irradiated, illuminated, kindled, and stimulated in charity toward the Good by the Influence, Light, and Motion of the DIVINE SUN. I require a follower of Pythagoras; one who is not a "precocious son" acting before his father; one who disputes and philosophizes **Theosophically**—that is, according to the Law and Testimony of Holy Scripture, the Book of Nature, and a right Conscience—not in a pagan or profane manner. Let such a reader, listener, contemplator, and judge be present; no other. Stay far away from here, you profane ones! Therefore, one must look around vigilantly to see who, of what kind, and of what greatness the suitors of this Amphitheater are; and JEHOVAH <note>The personal name of God in the Hebrew Bible.</note> must be consulted theosophically as to whom we should entrust the TRUE, Universal, and Triune PHILOSOPHY, and the Method of philosophizing used by those who are truly and universally Wise.

<margin>
To whom this Amphitheater is to be communicated, and to whom not.
</margin>

Certainly, these things are not to be brought forth rashly into every wandering ear or polluted conscience. For as Gregory of Nazianzus <note>A 4th-century Archbishop and theologian known as one of the "Cappadocian Fathers."</note> says, it is not permitted to dispute about GOD always and publicly; so too...

### OF THE ENTIRE WORK.

The more hidden arts are almost always met with infamy; the envy of "brothers" against one's ability, and the study of those who are false—indeed, many thousands of them—oppose it. Nevertheless, strengthened and animated by the divine **SPIRIT OF WISDOM AND STRENGTH**, who illuminated my mind as I reflected; gave me true confidence as I wrote; opened my mouth as I spoke, and even now as I speak, continues to open it; I have followed where the Fates called. By the guidance and power of this Spirit, persevering in holy zeal, I have <term>Theosophically</term> <note>Theosophically: In Khunrath's era, this referred to a specific type of "divine wisdom" that combined mystical theology with the study of nature (alchemy and physics) to understand God’s hidden workings.</note> overcome all those schemes. Thus, with **JEHOVAH** supplying the means and strength, I have at last—through weariness, obstacles, and misfortunes, as if through the Red Sea—successfully crossed over, escaping safe and unharmed from the labyrinth of those who wander in error.

Behold, I see **LAND**! Therefore, O **JEHOVAH**, **SPIRITUAL BEING, TRIUNE**, Eternal, Most Wise, Best, Most Powerful; **I AM WHO I AM** <note>original: "EHIEH ESER E EHIEH" — The Hebrew name revealed to Moses in Exodus 3:14.</note>, **JAH, JEHOVAH, ELOHIM, EL, ELOHIM GIBOR** <note>The Mighty God</note>, **ELOHAI** <note>My God</note>, **JEHOVAH ZEBAOTH SCHADAI** <note>Lord of Hosts, the Almighty</note>, **ADONAI MELECH** <note>The Lord King</note>; Terrible, Truthful, Strong, Zealous, Just, Long-suffering, Merciful, of great Kindness, All-seeing; **FATHER, SON, AND HOLY SPIRIT**; Creator of Heaven, Earth, Waters, and Founder of **ALL THINGS** which the whole **UNIVERSE** contains:

I, **HEINRICH KHUNRATH**—created in Wisdom, Goodness, Justice, Truth, Holiness, Great Power, and Immortality (within **ADAM**, the first-formed, just as all men are) according to your Image; truly one in person, but threefold in essence—composed of an earthly body, a heavenly spirit <note>original: "SCHAMAIM" — Hebrew for the Heavens.</note>, and a divinely inspired soul; formed as a **MAN** in your likeness; and by grace in **CHRIST**, reformed; I give you, the Most High, my most humble and greatest thanks, because you have mercifully heard my prayers, tears, vows, and sighs, which I have very often poured out to **YOU** in repentance since my earliest youth, seeking to obtain **TRUE WISDOM**; and that out of your pure kindness you have shown me the **TRUTH** of those matters which this present <term>Triune Amphitheater</term> <note>original: "Amphitheatrum Tertriunum"</note>, this <term>Universal Guide</term> <note>original: "Catholicon" — In alchemy, this refers to a universal medicine or truth that cures all ignorance.</note>, treats.

I pray with my whole heart for your **MERCY**, that you may send me from your holy heavens the **SPIRIT OF THE WISDOM OF GOD** <note>original: "RUACH HHOCHMAH-EL"</note>, the **SPIRIT OF YOUR WISDOM**, who may always stand by me as a familiar companion and guide me skillfully,

<sig>Ee 3</sig>

# EPILOGUE OR CONCLUSION OF THE ENTIRE WORK.

May He wisely advise and teach; may He be with me, may He Pray and Labor <note>original: "Oret, Laboret" — a reference to the famous alchemical and monastic motto "Ora et Labora" (Pray and Work).</note> with me; may He grant me to will well, to know, to be, and to be able in matters Physical, Physico-medical, Physico-Chemical, Physico-Magical, Hyperphysico-Magical, Cabalistic, and Theosophical of all kinds, **all of them:** in every action of my life; lest I wander from the way of Truth, and may the Light of Justice shine for me, and the **Sun** of Understanding rise for me in my mind and heart. That to You, O **Jehovah**, in good things and toward good things, I may be that which a man’s own hand is to him <note>Khunrath asks to be an instrument of God, as a hand is to a body.</note>; that I may solely follow the universal <note>original: "Catholicam"</note> **Truth** of Your **Wisdom**, which is Triune, Biblical, Macro- and Micro-Cosmic; and in **its** universal, triune Treasury <note>original: "Gazophylaceo"</note>—namely, in the Books of Holy Scripture, of Nature, and of a pure and upright Conscience—may I (having become a friend of **God**) legitimately pursue **Wisdom** and **True Philosophy** and the legitimate way of philosophizing. By the influence, I beseech You, by the Light and Movement of **YOUR SUPERCELESTIAL SUN**, bless me entirely. Kindly grant me, I pray, that with a sound mind in a sound body, I may have the means and the strength to bring to a perfectly complete end those things whose true Theory and Practice You have so wonderfully made known to me; may I use them with fruit and most freely, as long as I shall live, to Your honor, praise, and glory; for the honest benefit of my Neighbor (according to my Christian vow) and of myself; but for the eternal "fie" <note>original: "phy" — an exclamation of disgust or rejection</note> upon the devil and his scales <note>Likely referring to the "scales of the serpent" or the followers of evil.</note>. O **Lord**, let my **Angel** be with me on my right and left, before, behind, above and below, and even all around; Your good, flaming minister, who, according to the administration delegated by **You**, may put to flight the thieves lurking in the region of the air <note>In the cosmology of the time, the "air" was the dwelling place of demons and spirits.</note> or the malignant spirits, restrain their malice, and defend me from the "roaring lion walking about" <note>A reference to 1 Peter 5:8, describing the devil.</note>, lest he devour me; and finally, when I am surrounded by evil, let him warn and guard me, lest I perish. Deliver me, O **Lord**, from **all** evil; and thus, grant that I may pass through temporal things, lest in the meantime I lose **Eternal** Blessings; and may I enjoy **Jehovah** as Father, Brother, and Friend, for a universal salvation, most fruitful both here and in all Eternity: Through and because of the incarnate **Wisdom of the Father**, our Lord **Jesus Christ crucified**; who in the **Trinity** lives and reigns as **God** for ages of ages, **Amen.** From our Study <note>original: "Musæo"</note> in the year of the Christian era 1602.

->**HEINRICH KHUNRATH**<-
->**OF LEIPZIG, FAITHFUL LOVER**<-
->**OF THEOSOPHY, and Doctor**<-
->**of both Medicines.**<-

# EPILOGUE OR CONCLUSION OF THE ENTIRE WORK.

May He wisely advise and teach; may He be with me, may He Pray and Labor <note>original: "Oret, Laboret" — a reference to the famous alchemical and monastic motto "Ora et Labora" (Pray and Work).</note> with me; may He grant me to will well, to know, to be, and to be able in matters Physical, Physico-medical, Physico-Chemical, Physico-Magical, Hyperphysico-Magical, Cabalistic, and Theosophical of all kinds, **all of them:** in every action of my life; lest I wander from the way of Truth, and may the Light of Justice shine for me, and the **Sun** of Understanding rise for me in my mind and heart. That to You, O **Jehovah**, in good things and toward good things, I may be that which a man’s own hand is to him <note>Khunrath asks to be an instrument of God, as a hand is to a body.</note>; that I may solely follow the universal <note>original: "Catholicam" — used here in its literal sense of "universal" or "all-encompassing" rather than specifically Roman Catholic.</note> **Truth** of Your **Wisdom**, which is Triune, Biblical, Macro- and Micro-Cosmic; and in **its** universal, triune Treasury <note>original: "Gazophylaceo"</note>—namely, in the Books of Holy Scripture, of Nature, and of a pure and upright Conscience—may I (having become a friend of **God**) legitimately pursue **Wisdom** and **True Philosophy** and the legitimate way of philosophizing. By the influence, I beseech You, by the Light and Movement of **YOUR SUPERCELESTIAL SUN**, bless me entirely. Kindly grant me, I pray, that with a sound mind in a sound body, I may have the means and the strength to bring to a perfectly complete end those things whose true Theory and Practice You have so wonderfully revealed to me. Grant that I may successfully conclude them for the glory of Your Name, the benefit of the Church, and the use of my neighbor. Send me Your holy Angels as guardians, leaders, and teachers. Amen.

***

### GREETINGS TO THE SINCERE READER.

In the conclusion <note>original: "In calce"</note> of the explanations of each level <term>gradus: the seven stages of spiritual and scientific initiation described in this book</term>, sincere Reader, through an error these words have crept in: *Let the figure of the first, 2nd, 3rd, 4th, 5th, 6th, or 7th level be inserted.* Indeed, the individual levels do not have their own individual figures. Rather, the *Amphitheater* <note>The title of the work, "Amphitheatrum Sapientiae Aeternae"</note> itself is composed of its own figures and has its own Introductions. I wished to advise you of this so that you do not think anything is missing from the work. Farewell.

## HANAU
## Printed by Wilhelm Antonius,
## 1 6 0 9.
